- उपपत्ति: व्यतीपातमा सूर्य र चन्द्रमा विषुव वृत्तको दुवै तर्फ बराबर दूरीमा हुन्छन्, त्यसैले पात हुन्छ। वैधृतिमा पनि एउटै अहोरात्र वृत्तमा हुँदा पात हुन्छ। वियोग, व्यतीपात र वैधृतिमा पनि एउटै अहोरात्र वृत्तमा हुँदा वा विषुव वृत्तबाट दुवै तर्फ बराबर दूरीमा हुँदा पात हुन्छ।
- क्रान्तिको समानता गोलमा चन्द्र-क्रान्तिवृत्त सन्धिको नजिक प्रत्यक्ष देखिन्छ।
- अभावको उपपत्ति: चन्द्रमाको अयन सन्धिमा यसको क्रान्ति आफ्नो उत्तर वा दक्षिण परमक्रान्ति बराबर हुन्छ। त्यहाँबाट विक्षेप वृत्तमा अगाडि वा पछाडि जाँदा चन्द्रमाको क्रान्ति घट्ने सम्भावना हुन्छ। यसैले सन्धिमा सूर्यको क्रान्ति चन्द्रमाको क्रान्तिभन्दा बढी हुन्छ, र चन्द्रमाको क्रान्ति सूर्यको क्रान्तिसँग बराबर हुने अवस्था बन्दैन।
- सूर्य चन्द्रमाभन्दा ढिलो चल्ने भएकाले सूर्यको क्रान्ति घट्दा चन्द्रमाको क्रान्ति पनि घट्छ, र बराबरी पछि मात्र सम्भव हुन्छ।
- पातको मध्य समयका लागि नियममा भनिएको 'मानयोगार्ध' को सट्टा क्रान्ति अन्तर र मान-ऐक्य खण्डको अन्तरको आधा लिएर गणना गर्नु पर्छ।
commentaries.en:
- Now the special characteristic of pāta is stated.
- 'Yadā' means at what time; 'viṣuvan-nikaṭe' means near the equinox, that is, near the state where the declination is nearly absent.
- Here it should be understood that the moon's true declination is near zero.
- Equality of the declinations of the sun and the moon then occurs.
- At that time, near it, in gross form, because the declination is absent, a pāta consisting of the two divisions vaidhṛti and vyatīpāta occurs on both sides.
- 'Dvi' means each occurs twofold, so the pair happens twice.
- 'Viparyayāt' means from the reversal already described (vyatyāsa).
- The sense is that the two declinations are equal near the junction of the moon's path (the moon's ayana-sandhi).
- Here inequality should be understood only as the moon's true declination being less than the sun's declination, not greater.
- 'Abhāva' means that the pāta, which is the state of equal declinations, arises only in a small measure at that gross time.
- Ranganatha quotes Bhāskarācārya: at the solar-ayana junction the moon's declination is less than the sun's declination at that moment; until then the two declinations are not equal.
- The method of calculation: take the arc obtained first, add or subtract the required degrees to the moon, and repeat the process each time, so the pāta time is found twofold.
- Upapatti: in the vyatīpāta, sun and moon stand at equal distance on both sides of the equator, so there is pāta. Likewise in vaidhṛti, when they lie on one day-night circle, there is pāta. Similarly for viyoga, vyatīpāta and vaidhṛti, when they lie on one day-night circle, or stand at equal distance from the equator on both sides, there is pāta.
- Equality of declination is evident from the sphere, near the moon-ecliptic junction.
- Upapatti of the absence: at the moon's ayana-junction, the moon's declination equals its maximum north or south distance from the equator. From there, in the deflection circle, the moon's declination tends to decrease ahead or behind. Hence the sun's declination at the junction is greater than the moon's declination at that junction, and equality of the moon's declination with the sun's is not produced.
- The sun moves slowly relative to the moon, so when the sun's declination decreases, the moon's declination decreases as well, and equality becomes possible only later.
- Regarding the pāta-middle: at the same time, the rule's 'half the sum of sun and moon measures' is replaced by half the sum of the two declination differences and the diameters, as the calculation requires.

commentaries.ne:
पाण्डेयको उपपत्ति, चरणबद्ध रूपमा:
१. सूर्य सूर्य-सन्धिको नजिक छ र क्रान्ति बराबर छ भनी कल्पना गर्ने। चन्द्रमा उत्तर गोलमा छ र सूर्य पनि उत्तर गोलमा छ, तर अयन भिन्न छ।
२. यस समयमा व्यतीपात हुन्छ, जुन चन्द्रमाको शर (क्रान्ति) शून्य हुँदा हुन्छ।
३. त्यसपछि चन्द्रमाको मध्यम स्थिति ७० कला अगाडि बढ्छ, र सूर्यको मध्यम स्थितिमा अलिकति मात्र फरक पर्छ।
४. यस चरणमा चन्द्रमाको गति सूर्यको गतिको तेह्रौँ भाग मानिन्छ।
५. दुई भुज बराबर हुने र चन्द्रमाको शर शून्य हुने भएकाले क्रान्ति फेरि बराबर हुन्छ, र दोस्रो पटक पात हुन्छ।
६. यसरी पात दुई पटक हुन्छ। 'न होकायनगतौ स्याताम्' भन्ने लक्षणले पात दुई पटक हुने कुरा दिन्छ। विद्वानहरूले यो राम्ररी विचार गर्नु पर्छ।
७. सूर्यको अयन सन्धिको नजिक क्रान्ति बराबर नभएमा धेरै समयसम्म पात हुँदैन।
commentaries.en:
Pandey's proof (उपपत्ति), summarized step by step:
1. Assume the sun is near the solar junction and the declinations are equal. Let the moon be in the northern hemisphere and the sun also in the northern hemisphere, but on different solstitial halves (ayana differs).
2. At this moment the vyatīpāta occurs, which is the case when the moon's declination (śara) is zero.
3. Afterwards, the moon's mean longitude advances by 70 kalā, and the sun's mean longitude changes only slightly.
4. The moon's motion is taken as one-thirteenth part of the sun's motion in the given step.
5. Because the two arms (bhuja) become equal and the moon's declination is zero, the declinations become equal again, and the pāta occurs a second time.
6. Thus the pāta occurs twice. The condition 'na hi ekāyanagatau syātām' gives the pāta twice, as the definition states. Learned readers should consider this well.
7. When the declinations are not equal near the sun's ayana junction, the pāta is absent for a long time.

commentaries.ne:
कपिलेश्वरको टिप्पणी (तत्त्वामृत र टिप्पणी), श्लोक १९ मा:
- 'विषुवत् सन्निधि' भनेको नाडीवृत्त र क्रान्तिवृत्तको सन्धिको नजिक, अर्थात् रविगोल सन्धिको नजिक हो।
- त्यहाँ सूर्य र चन्द्रमाको क्रान्ति बराबर हुँदा पात निश्चय नै दुई पटक हुन्छ।
- 'विपर्यय' भनेको क्रान्ति दुई पटक बराबर नभएमा पात हुँदैन भन्ने हो।
- उपपत्ति: सूर्य र चन्द्रमा फरक गोलमा भए पनि एउटै अयनमा हुँदा दुवैको योग आधा भगण हुन्छ, र त्यसबेला पात हुन्छ।
- उदाहरण: दक्षिण अयनमा सूर्य रविगोल सन्धिको नजिक, तेस्रो पदमा ६ राशि १० अंशमा छ; उत्तर गोलमा चन्द्रमा दोस्रो पदमा ५ राशि २९० अंशमा छ। भुजको मान बराबर र चन्द्रमाको शर शून्य हुँदा पात हुन्छ।
- चन्द्रमाको अयन सन्धिमा क्रान्ति सूर्यको भन्दा कम हुँदा समानता हुँदैन, र त्यसबेला पात हुँदैन।
- भास्कराचार्यको श्लोक उद्धृत गर्छन्: सूर्यको अयन सन्धिदेखि क्रान्ति बराबर नहुन्जेल चन्द्रमाको क्रान्ति सूर्यभन्दा कम रहन्छ।
- पातको अवधि भनेको दुई बिम्ब एउटै मार्गमा रहने समय हो।
commentaries.en:
Kapileshwar's note on verse 19 (Tattvamṛta and notes):
- 'Viṣuvat sannidhi' means near the junction of the nāḍīvṛtta and the kranti-vṛtta, that is, near the ravigolasandhi (the solar node).
- When the declinations of the sun and the moon are equal there, the pāta is certain to occur twice.
- 'Viparyaya' means that if the declinations are not equal twice, then the pāta does not occur.
- Upapatti: the lakṣaṇa stated as 'the sun and moon being in the same ayana' is taken; when the sun and moon lie in different spheres but on the same ayana, their sum equals half a revolution, and the pāta occurs.
- Kapileshwar works an example: the sun near the solar junction in the southern ayana, in the third quadrant at 6 rāśi 10 degrees; the moon in the northern hemisphere in the second quadrant at 5 rāśi 290 degrees. Because the bhuja values are equal and the moon's declination is zero, the pāta occurs.
- He adds that when the moon's declination at its ayana junction is less than the sun's, there is no equality, and the pāta is absent.
- He quotes Bhāskara: from the time of the sun's ayana junction, the moon's declination remains less than the sun's until the declinations are equal, and the equality is the condition for the pāta.
- The duration of the pāta is the time during which the two bimbas share a common path; he quotes: 'Equality of declinations lasts until the half-sum of the two diameters is less than the difference of declinations of the bimba parts.'

shlokas.sanskrit: शशाङ्कार्कयुतेर्लिप्ता भभोगेन विभाजिता । लब्धं सप्तदशान्तोऽन्यो व्यतीपातस्तृतीयकः
shlokas.meaning_ne: सूर्य र चन्द्रमाको भोग कलामा जोड्नुहोस् र त्यसलाई ८०० ले भाग गर्नुहोस्। ८०० एउटा योगको मान हो। भागफल सत्र अघि (सोह्रपछि, सत्र नपुगेसम्म) पर्यो भने त्यो क्षण तेस्रो व्यतीपात हो। यो पहिले भनिएका क्रान्तिसाम्य व्यतीपात र वैधृतिभन्दा फरक हो। यो सबै शुभ कार्यमा वर्जित छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Take the sum of the sun's and moon's longitudes, in kalās, and divide it by 800, the span of one yoga. If the quotient falls just before the 17th yoga (after 16, up to 17), the moment is a third Vyatipāta pāta, distinct from the equal-declination Vyatipāta and from Vaidhṛti. It is forbidden for all auspicious acts.

commentaries.ne:
श्लोकले पञ्चाङ्गका योगभित्र अर्को निषिद्ध पात बताउँछ, किनभने अघि भनिएका निषिद्ध पातहरू सबै पात होइनन्।
सूर्य र चन्द्रमाको भोग कलाको योगफललाई ८०० ले भाग गरिन्छ; ८०० एउटा नक्षत्र-योगको कला-मान हो। भागफललाई योग-संख्या मानिन्छ।
भागफल सोह्रपछि र सत्रसम्म पर्यो भने त्यो सत्रौं योग हुन्छ, र त्यस बेलाको व्यतीपात तेस्रो हुन्छ।
'तृतीयक' शब्दको अर्थ 'तेस्रो' हो, किनभने व्यतीपात दुई प्रकारको छ: क्रान्तिसाम्यबाट र सूर्य-चन्द्र भोगान्तरबाट।
यही तर्कले छब्बीसपछिको सत्ताईसौं योग तेस्रो वैधृति हुन्छ, र त्यो पनि सबै शुभ कार्यमा वर्जित छ।
टीकाअनुसार यो पात-स्थिति अघिका श्लोकमा भनिएकोभन्दा फरक हो र ती दुवैबाट भिन्न छ।
commentaries.en:
The verse fixes a further forbidden pāta within the pañcāṅga yogas, since the forbidden pātas named earlier were not all of the pātas.
The kalās of the sun and moon's sum are divided by 800, the kalā measure of one nakṣatra-yoga; the quotient is taken as the yoga-number.
When the quotient lies after 16 and up to 17, the yoga is the 17th, and the Vyatipāta that occurs then is a third one.
The word tṛtīyaka means 'the third', because Vyatipāta is two-fold: by equal declination (kranti-sāmya) and by the sun-moon longitude difference (yogāntara).
By the same reasoning, the 27th yoga, after the 26th, is a third Vaidhṛti, also forbidden for all auspicious acts.
The commentary says this pāta-state is not the one from the earlier verses and is distinct from both.

Pandey's proof (अत्रोपपत्ति) is one line: the result is the 17th of the 27 yogas, counted from Viṣkambha, and this is the Vyatipāta yoga of the pañcāṅga.
He adds that the yoga is the Vyatipāta of the Pañcāṅga, not the Vyatipāta of equal declination named in the earlier verse.
He notes that the verse's yoga-based pāta is separate from the declination-based pāta of verses 17 to 19.

commentaries.ne:
कपिलेश्वरको तत्त्वामृतले सूर्य र चन्द्रमाको कलाको योगफललाई ८०० ले भाग गरेर भागफललाई योग-संख्या मान्छ।
भागफल सत्रौं योगमा पुगेमा हालको योग व्यतीपात हुन्छ, जुन तेस्रो पात हो।
यो तेस्रो भनिन्छ किनभने यो क्रान्तिसाम्य र भोगान्तरका पातभन्दा भिन्न हो।
यही योग-गणना नियम वैधृति योगका लागि पनि लागू हुन्छ।
commentaries.en:
Kapileshwar's Tattvamrita takes the quotient of the sum of kalās divided by 800 as the yoga-number.
If the quotient reaches the 17th, the current yoga is Vyatipāta, which is the third pāta.
It is called the third because it is distinct from the pātas of equal declination and of longitude difference.
The same yoga-count rule is used for the Vaidhṛti yoga.

Mishra's Hindi tika restates the rule and says the same method yields the third Vaidhṛti, the 27th yoga after the 26th.
His rendering reads the quotient as 27 at the end, while the root verse and Ranganatha give 17 for Vyatipāta; this is a discrepancy to note.

shlokas.working_en:
1. Length of one yoga in kalās = 21600 ÷ 27 = 800 kalās (the full zodiac is 360° × 60 = 21600 kalās, shared by 27 yogas).
2. Sum of longitudes in kalās = sun's kalās + moon's kalās.
3. Yoga count = (sun + moon kalās) ÷ 800.
4. If the quotient lies between 16 and 17, the yoga is the 17th, Vyatipāta (third pāta).
shlokas.working_ne:
१. एउटा योगको कला-मान = २१६०० ÷ २७ = ८०० कला (पूर्ण राशिचक्र ३६० × ६० = २१६०० कला, जसलाई २७ योगले बाँडछन्)।
२. भोग कलाको योगफल = सूर्यको कला + चन्द्रमाको कला।
३. योग-संख्या = (सूर्य + चन्द्रमाको कला) ÷ ८००।
४. भागफल सोह्र र सत्रबीच पर्यो भने योग सत्रौं हो, जुन व्यतीपात (तेस्रो पात) हो।

shlokas.sanskrit: सार्पेन्द्रपौष्ण्यधिष्ण्यानामन्त्या: पादा भसन्धय: । तदग्रभेष्वाद्यपादो गण्डान्तं नाम कीर्त्यते
shlokas.meaning_ne: आश्लेषा, ज्येष्ठा र रेवती नक्षत्रको अन्तिम चौथो चरण भसन्धि हो, अर्थात् नक्षत्रहरूबीचको जोड हो। यिनीहरूपछिका मघा, मूल र अश्विनी नक्षत्रका पहिलो चरणलाई गण्डान्त भनिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The last quarters (fourth pādas) of the nakshatras Āśleṣā, Jyeṣṭhā and Revatī are called bhasandhi, the junctions between nakshatras. The first quarter of the nakshatras that follow them, Maghā, Mūla and Aśvinī, is called gaṇḍānta, the inauspicious junction. Pandey's translation states this directly.

commentaries.ne:
- आश्लेषा, ज्येष्ठा र रेवतीको अन्तिम (चौथो) चरण भसन्धि हो।
- तदग्रभेषु भनेको तिनीहरूपछिका नक्षत्र हुन्: मघा, मूल र अश्विनी।
- तिनका पहिलो चरणलाई गण्डान्त भनिन्छ, जुन सर्वविदित छ।
- आपत्ति: आश्लेषा आदिका अन्तिम दुई घटी र मघा आदिका पहिला दुई घटी मिलेर चार घटी गण्डान्त हुन्छ। एउटा नक्षत्रको अन्त्य र अर्कोको आरम्भबीचको अन्तराल, अर्थात् चन्द्रमण्डल, थप दुई घटी हुन्छ। जम्मा लगभग अढाई घटी हुन्छ, जुन संहिता-विरुद्ध हो। तर सूर्यको आफ्नै कथनको स्वतः प्रामाण्य छ, त्यसैले दोष छैन।
- वैकल्पिक पाठ: यहाँ पाद शब्द दुई जनाउने संख्यावाचक हो, जसरी कर्ण (कान) र नेत्र (आँखा) दुई जनाउँछन्। घटी शब्द अध्याहार गरिन्छ। तब अन्तिम दुई घटी भसन्धि हुन्छन्, र तिनपछिका पहिला दुई घटी गण्डान्त हुन्छन्।
- आपत्ति: यदि गण्डान्त भनेको भसन्धिहरूबीचको अन्तराल हो भने भसन्धि भनिनु अनुचित हो।
- उत्तर: दुवै भनिए पनि उद्देश्य निषिद्ध समय भन्नु हो। बीचको समयले पछिल्ला समय झन् बढी निषिद्ध हुन्छन् भन्ने संकेत गर्छ।
commentaries.en:
- Āśleṣā, Jyeṣṭhā and Revatī: their final (fourth) quarters are the nakshatra junctions (bhasandhi).
- Tadagra-bheṣu means in the nakshatras that follow them: Maghā, Mūla and Aśvinī.
- The first quarter of those is called gaṇḍānta, as is well known.
- Objection: the last two ghaṭikās of Āśleṣā etc. and the first two ghaṭikās of Maghā etc. make four ghaṭikās of gaṇḍānta. The interval between the end of one nakshatra and the start of the next, the moon's disc, adds two more. Together that is about 2.5 ghaṭikās, which contradicts the Saṃhitā. But Sūrya's own statement is authoritative in itself, so there is no fault.
- Alternative reading: pāda here is a numeral meaning two, as karṇa (ear) and netra (eye) mean two. Ghaṭikā is understood. Then the last two ghaṭikās are the junctions, and the first two ghaṭikās after them are gaṇḍānta.
- Objection: if gaṇḍānta is the interval between the junctions, mentioning the junctions is improper.
- Answer: although both are stated, the purpose is to state the prohibited time. The intervening time implies that the times following it are even more prohibited.

shlokas.sanskrit: व्यतीपातत्रयं घोरं गण्डान्तत्रितयं तथा । एतद्भसन्धित्रितयं सर्वकर्मसु वर्जयेत्
shlokas.meaning_ne: तीन व्यतीपात, तीन गण्डान्त र तीन भसन्धि सबै घोर अर्थात अशुभ छन्। यसकारण यी चारै समूहलाई सबै शुभ कार्यमा वर्जित गर्नुपर्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The three vyatipātas, the three gaṇḍāntas and the three bha-sandhis are all ghora, inauspicious. Therefore these four groups are to be avoided in every auspicious act. The verse thus treats them as equally prohibited, as the preceding topics were.

commentaries.ne:
व्यतीपातको त्रय: दुई व्यतीपात, योग र वियोग स्वभावका, क्रान्तिसाम्य भएका र विषुवको नजिक हुन्छन्। क्रान्तिसाम्यको अन्तरले बनेको व्यतीपात भनेको ती दुईकै भेद हो, छुट्टै होइन।
तेस्रो व्यतीपात पञ्चाङ्गभित्रको योगभित्र पर्ने व्यतीपात हो। त्रय स्पष्ट छ।
उपलक्षणले वैधृति-त्रय पनि यही हो: योग र वियोग स्वभावका, क्रान्तिसाम्य भएका दुई वैधृति, विषुवको नजिक। वैधृति नाम भएको एउटा तिनीहरूभित्र पर्छ र छुट्टै होइन। तेस्रो पञ्चाङ्गभित्रको योगभित्र पर्ने वैधृति-योग हो।
केहीले व्यतीपात र वैधृतिलाई नामभेदले फरक दुई व्यतीपात मान्छन्, पहिले भनिएजस्तै। यसकारण व्यतीपात-त्रय भनेको शब्दशः सुनिएजस्तै पञ्चाङ्गभित्रको योगमा पर्ने व्यतीपात हो।
घोर भनेको दुष्ट हो। गण्डान्त-त्रय र नक्षत्र-सन्धि-त्रय पनि पहिले भनिएजस्तै घोर हुन्।
यसकारण शुभ कार्यको इच्छा गर्ने मानिसले सबै शुभ कर्ममा यी दुष्ट कालहरू त्याग्नुपर्छ।
commentaries.en:
The verse says the topics already described are equally prohibited (tulya-niṣiddhatva).
Vyatipāta triad: two vyatipātas, of the nature of yoga and viyoga, have equal declination (kranti-sāmya) and occur near the equinox. The vyatipāta that is only a different name for the same event is not a separate one; the two are the same thing, and the difference lies only in the naming.
The third is the vyatipāta included within a yoga that is itself within the pañcāṅga. The triad is clear.
By extension (upalakṣaṇa), the vaidhṛti triad is the same: two vaidhṛtis, of yoga and viyoga nature, with equal declination near the equinox. The vaidhṛti-named one lies within them and is not separate. The third is the vaidhṛti-yoga included within a yoga within the pañcāṅga.
Some teachers hold that vyatipāta and vaidhṛti are two vyatipātas distinguished by name, as stated earlier, and so the vyatipāta triad is the one included in a yoga within the pañcāṅga, as literally read.
Ghora means dusta, bad. The gaṇḍānta triad and the nakṣatra-sandhi triad are likewise ghora, as stated before.
Therefore a person who wants auspiciousness in all auspicious acts should abandon these inauspicious periods.

commentaries.ne:
तत्त्वामृतले भन्छ, श्लोक २१ र २२ सँगै: आश्लेषा, ज्येष्ठा र रेवती नक्षत्रका चौथो चरण (अन्तिम पाद) भसन्धि हुन्, र ती नक्षत्रका योगस्थान भसन्धि हुन्।
आश्लेषाको अन्त्यमा कर्कटको अन्त्य र सिंहको आरम्भ। ज्येष्ठाको अन्त्यमा वृश्चिकको अन्त्य र धनुको आरम्भ। रेवतीको अन्त्यमा मीनको अन्त्य र मेषको आरम्भ। यिनलाई भसन्धि भनिन्छ।
मघा, मूल र अश्विनीको पहिलो पाद गण्डान्त हो।
घोर व्यतीपात-त्रय, गण्डान्त-त्रय र भसन्धि-त्रय अशुभ हुन्, त्यसैले सबै शुभ कार्यमा त्याग्नुपर्छ।
जातक ग्रन्थमा व्यतीपात-त्रय र गण्डान्त-त्रयमा जन्मदा हानि हुने भनिएको छ, र ती सबै कथन ती ग्रन्थहरूमै बुझ्नुपर्छ।
commentaries.en:
Tattvāmṛta, on verses 21 and 22 together: the bha-sandhis are the junction points of the nakṣatras Āśleṣā, Jyeṣṭhā and Revatī, whose fourth quarters (last pādas) are bha-sandhis.
At the end of Āśleṣā: the end of Karkaṭa and the start of Siṁha. At the end of Jyeṣṭhā: the end of Vṛścika and the start of Dhanus. At the end of Revatī: the end of Mīna and the start of Meṣa. These are called bha-sandhis.
The gaṇḍānta is the first quarter of Maghā, Mūla and Aśvinī; these are called gaṇḍānta.
The ghora vyatipāta triad, the gaṇḍānta triad and the bha-sandhi triad are inauspicious, so they are to be avoided in all auspicious acts.
In jātaka texts, birth during the vyatipāta and gaṇḍānta triads is said to be harmful, and all such statements should be understood as applying to those texts.

commentaries.ne: मिश्रको हिन्दी टीकाले पाण्डेयको अर्थभन्दा माथि थप्छ: भसन्धिलाई सन्धिगत काल, अर्थात जोड्ने समय भनेर व्याख्या गर्छ।
commentaries.en: Mishra's Hindi tika adds one gloss beyond Pandey's meaning: it renders bha-sandhi as sandhigata kāl, the junction times.

shlokas.sanskrit: इत्येतत् परमं पुण्यं ज्योतिषां चरितं हितम् । रहस्यं महदाख्यातं किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि
shlokas.meaning_ne: सूर्य पुरुषले मयासुरलाई आफ्नो उपदेश यहाँ समाप्त गर्दै भन्छन्। ग्रह र नक्षत्रहरूको यो चरित्र अत्यन्त पवित्र, हितकारी र महान रहस्य हो। अब यसभन्दा बाहेक अरू के सुन्न चाहनुहुन्छ भनी उनी सोध्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: The Surya Purusha closes his teaching to Maya. This account of the planets and stars is supremely sacred, beneficial, and a great secret. He asks whether Maya wishes to hear anything beyond what has already been told.

commentaries.ne:
रङ्गनाथले यो श्लोकलाई एघारौँ अध्यायको समापन मान्छन्, जहाँ असुर मयलाई 'हे मय' भनी सम्बोधन गरिएको छ।
'एकमना सुन' देखि 'सबै कर्महरूमा त्याग्नुपर्छ' सम्मका वाक्यहरूलाई उपदेशको रूपमा व्याख्या गर्छन्।
ज्योतिषाम् भनेको ग्रह र नक्षत्र हो; चरित भनेको तिनको महिमा, अर्थात् गणितादि ज्ञान हो।
हितम् भनेको यस लोकमा हितकारी र यश दिने हो।
परमं पुण्यम् भनेको परलोकमा उत्कृष्ट धर्म हो।
यसैले यो महान रहस्य हो, र अत्यन्त गोप्य हो; सूर्य पुरुषले यो भनिसकेको बताउँछन्।
मयको मनमा अघि भनिएको कुरा बुझिएको थिएन। यो मयको तल्लो ओठको काम्नुबाट अनुमान गरिएको हो।
मयले आफ्नो शंका खोल्न सङ्कोच गर्ने भएकाले, पुरुषले यस उपदेशपछि जे सुन्न चाहन्छ सो सोध्न भन्छन्।
अर्थ यस्तो छ: 'मैले तिमीलाई जहाँ भनेँ, त्यहाँ तिमीलाई जुन शंका छ, त्यसमा सङ्कोच त्यागेर मलाई सोध; म उत्तर दिनेछु।'
रङ्गनाथ थप्छन् कि गणित खगोलशास्त्रको दश भागको ग्रन्थको पहिलो आधा पाताधिकारले समाप्त हुन्छ, जुन 'यत् परमं पुण्यम्' ले सङ्केत गरिएको छ।
उनका समापन श्लोकहरूले भन्छन् कि पाताधिकार गूढार्थप्रकाशकमा पूरा भएको छ।
उनी चाहन्छन् कि गणकहरूले यो पढेर सुख पाउन्।
commentaries.en:
Ranganatha introduces the verse as the closing of the eleventh chapter, where the Asura Maya is addressed as 'hey Maya'.
He explains 'listen with one mind' and what follows as the teaching given, up to 'should be avoided in all rites'.
Jyotisham means the planets and stars; carita means their greatness, that is, knowledge of mathematics and the like.
Hitam means beneficial in this world, bringing fame.
Param punyam means the highest dharma in the next world.
For this reason it is a great secret, and it is very confidential; Surya's Purusha says he has told it.
He notes that Maya's mind had not grasped the matter explained earlier. This is inferred from the trembling of Maya's lower lip.
Since Maya is too shy to reveal his doubts, the Purusha asks him, after this teaching, to ask whatever else he wishes to hear.
The meaning is: 'whatever doubt you have where I have told you, set aside your hesitation and ask me; I will answer.'
Ranganatha adds that the ten-part treatise on mathematical astronomy has its first half ended with the Patadhikara, which the verse indicates by 'this supremely sacred...'.
His closing verses state that the Patadhikara is complete in the Gudharthaprakashika, a commentary on the Surya Siddhanta's hidden meanings.
They wish that calculators find happiness by reading it.

commentaries.ne:
कपिलेश्वरको तत्त्वामृतले पुरुषले 'हे मय' भनी सम्बोधन गरेको व्याख्या गर्छ।
परमं पुण्यम् भनेको धर्मले भरिएको हो, र हितम् भनेको सधैँ हितकारी हो।
रहस्यम् भनेको सबैभन्दा गोप्य हो, कम बुझ्ने मानिसलाई नदिनुपर्ने।
ज्योतिषाम् ले नक्षत्रहरूलाई जनाउँछ, र महत् भनेको मैले तिमीलाई नघटाई भनेको चरित हो।
उनी सोध्छन्, 'फेरि के सुन्न चाहन्छौ?' यदि तिमीलाई अरू सुन्ने इच्छा छ भने पनि सोध्न सक्छौ; म सबै भन्नेछु।
उनको समापन लेखमा भनिएको छ कि सूर्यसिद्धान्तको पूर्वार्ध (पहिलो आधा) एघार अध्यायको पाताधिकारमा समाप्त हुन्छ।
उनले आफूलाई चातुरध्वरिक श्री कपिलेश्वर शास्त्री, मैथिल भनी परिचय दिन्छन्।
commentaries.en:
Kapileshwar's Tattvamrita explains the Purusha addressing 'hey Maya'.
Param punyam means full of dharma, and hitam means always beneficial.
Rahasyam means most secret, not to be revealed to those of poor understanding.
Jyotisham refers to the nakshatras, and mahat means carita told by me to you without reduction.
He asks, 'what else do you wish to hear again?' If you have any other wish to hear, you may also ask; I will tell you all of it.
His colophon says the Surya Siddhanta's purvardha (first half) ends with the Patadhikara, in eleven chapters.
He identifies himself as Chaturadhvarika Shri Kapileshwara Shastri, a Maithil.

commentaries.ne: मिश्रको हिन्दी टीकाले एघारौँ अध्यायको समाप्ति र ग्रन्थको पहिलो खण्ड (पूर्वखण्ड) पूरा भएको जनाउँछ। यसले उत्तरखण्ड बाह्रौँ अध्याय भूगोलबाट सुरु हुने भन्छ।
commentaries.en: Mishra's Hindi tika marks the end of the eleventh chapter and the completion of the first half (purvakhanda) of the text. It says the uttarakhanda begins with the twelfth chapter, Bhugola.

shlokas.sanskrit: अथार्कांशसमुद्भूतं प्रणिपत्य कृताञ्जलिः । भक्त्या परमयाऽभ्यर्च्य पप्रच्छेदं मयासुरः
shlokas.meaning_ne: त्यसपछि मयासुरले हात जोडेर सूर्यको अंशबाट उत्पन्न पुरुषलाई प्रणाम गरे, परम भक्तिले पूजा गरे र उहाँसँग यो सोधे।
shlokas.meaning_en: Then Mayāsura, with folded hands, bowed to the being born of a portion of the Sun, worshipped him with the highest devotion, and asked him this.

commentaries.ne: मयासुर लङ्काधिपति रावणका ससुरा हुन् भनी चिनाइएको छ। उनले हात जोडेर अञ्जलि मुद्रा गरेको देखाइएको छ। उनले सूर्यका अंशबाट उत्पन्न पुरुषलाई सेवकको भावले अत्यन्त भक्तिपूर्वक र सबै प्रकारले पूजा गरे। 'प्रच्छ' शब्दलाई 'पृष्टवान्' भनी व्याख्या गरिएको छ।
commentaries.en: Mayasura is identified as the father-in-law of Ravana, lord of Lanka. He is shown making the anjali mudra, the gesture of joined palms. He worships the Sun-born Purusha with supreme devotion, in the attitude of a servant, and worships him in every way. The verb 'pracchа' (asked) is glossed as 'pṛṣṭavān'.

shlokas.sanskrit: भगवन्! किम्प्रमाणा भूः किमाकारा किमाश्रया । किंविभागा कथं चात्र सप्तपातालभूमयः
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे भगवन्! यो पृथ्वीको परिमाण के हो, यसको आकार कस्तो हो, र यो कुनमा आधारित छ? यसका विभाग कति छन्, र यसभित्र सात पाताल-भूमिहरू कसरी छन्? यो श्लोक पृथ्वीबारे गरिएका पहिलो प्रश्नहरूमध्ये एक हो।
shlokas.meaning_en: O Lord, what is the measure of the earth, what is its shape, and what supports it? What are its divisions, and how are the seven netherworld regions (pātāla-bhūmi) arranged within it? This verse is the first of the questions put to the teacher about the earth.

commentaries.ne:
रङ्गनाथले यो श्लोकलाई पृथ्वीबारे गरिएका प्रश्नहरूको पहिलो समूह मान्छन्।
'भूः' भनेको पृथ्वी हो।
'किम्प्रमाणा' ले पृथ्वीको परिमाण के हो भनी सोध्छ।
'किमाकारा' ले यसको आकार कस्तो हो भनी सोध्छ, किनकि पृथ्वीका विभिन्न स्थानमा दिन र रात फरक हुन्छन्।
'किमाश्रया' ले यो केमा आधारित छ भनी सोध्छ, किनकि ग्रहहरू पृथ्वीको चारैतिर घुम्छन् भन्ने कुरा बताइएको छ, त्यसैले आधारमा शंका हुन्छ; आधार नभएको पृथ्वी टिक्न सक्दैन।
'किंविभागा' ले पृथ्वीका विभाग कति छन् भनी सोध्छ, जस्तै द्वीप र वर्षहरू।
'कथं' ले सात पाताल-भूमिहरू, अर्थात् पुराणमा भनिएका सात लोक, कुन उपायले विभाजित र व्यवस्थित छन् भनी सोध्छ।
'च' ले प्रश्नहरूलाई जोड्छ र प्रत्येकमा लागू हुन्छ।
परिमाणबारे प्रश्न गरिएको कारण हो कि पृथ्वीको विस्तार पहिले नै बताइएको थियो (योजनानि शतान्यष्टौ, पञ्चाशत्कोटिविस्तीर्णा); यो परिमाण सबैले जानेको परिमाणभन्दा फरक हुनाले गुरुको भनाइमा शंका भयो र फेरि सोधियो। नत्र प्रश्न व्यर्थ हुन्थ्यो र पहिले भनिसकिएको कुरा दोहोरिन्थ्यो।
आकारबारे प्रश्न गरिएको कारण हो कि गोलाकार पृथ्वीले फरक देखिने अवस्था बुझाउन सक्दैन, त्यसैले गुरुको आकार सर्वसम्मत आकारभन्दा फरक हुन्छ।
आधारबारे र पछिका प्रश्नहरू पनि त्यसैगरी उठेका हुन्, किनकि तिनीहरू सबैले जानेको रूपभन्दा बाहिरको पृथ्वीको स्वरूपसँग सम्बन्धित छन्।
commentaries.en:
Ranganatha says this verse is the first set of questions about the earth, put to the teacher.
He glosses 'bhūḥ' as the earth.
'Kimpramāṇā' asks what measure the earth has.
'Kimākārā' asks what form it has, since day and night differ from place to place on the earth.
'Kimāśrayā' asks what it rests on, since the planets are said to move all around the earth, so a support is doubted; an earth without support cannot stand.
'Kimvibhāgā' asks what divisions the earth has, such as the dvīpas and varṣas.
'Kathaṃ' asks by what means the seven pātāla-bhūmis, the seven worlds of the Purāṇas, are divided and arranged.
'Ca' links the questions and applies to each of them.
The question on measure is raised because the earth's extent was already given (yojanāni śatānyaṣṭau, pañcāśatkoṭivistīrṇā); this measure differs from the one known to all people, so the teacher's statement is doubted and asked again. Otherwise the question would be pointless and repeat what was already said.
The question on shape is asked because a spherical earth cannot explain the differing appearances, so the teacher's shape differs from the one commonly accepted.
The questions on support and the later ones are likewise raised because they concern the earth's form beyond what all people know.

commentaries.ne:
कपिलेश्वरले 'प्रमाण' शब्दलाई अमरकोषका आधारमा 'हेतु' (कारण) अर्थमा लिन्छन्, त्यसैले परिमाणबारेको प्रश्नले पृथ्वीको अस्तित्वको कारण के हो भनी सोध्छ।
उनले भन्छन् कि अघि भनिएको 'योजनानि शतान्यष्टौ' ले पृथ्वीको विस्तार बताउँछ, त्यसैले यो प्रश्न त्यही परिमाणको दोहोरो उल्लेख होइन।
'किमाकारा' ले पृथ्वीको आकार कस्तो हो भनी सोध्छ, किनकि यसको स्थानस्थानमा दिन र रात फरक देखिन्छन्।
'किमाश्रया' ले पृथ्वी केमा अडिएको छ भनी सोध्छ; ग्रहहरू पृथ्वीको वरिपरि घुम्छन् भन्ने कुराले यो प्रश्न उठाउँछ।
'किंविभागा' ले द्वीप, वर्ष र अन्य क्षेत्रहरूले पृथ्वीमा कस्ता विभाग बनाउँछन् भनी सोध्छ।
'कथं' ले पुराणका सात पाताल-लोकहरू कुन विधिले व्यवस्थित छन् भनी सोध्छ।
commentaries.en:
Kapileshwar reads 'pramāṇa' in the sense of 'hetu' (cause), citing the Amarakośa, so the question on measure asks what the cause of the earth's existence is.
He notes that the earlier statement 'yojanāni śatānyaṣṭau' gives the earth's extent, so this question is not a repetition of that measure.
'Kimākārā' asks what form the earth has, since its appearance (day and night) differs at different places on it.
'Kimāśrayā' asks what the earth rests on; the question is raised because the planets move around the earth.
'Kimvibhāgā' asks what divisions the dvīpas, varṣas and other regions form on the earth.
'Kathaṃ' asks by what method the seven pātāla-lokas of the Purāṇas are arranged.

shlokas.sanskrit: अहोरात्रव्यवस्थां च विदधाति कथं रविः । कथं पर्येति वसुधां भुवनानि विभावयन्
shlokas.meaning_ne: सूर्यले दिन र रातको व्यवस्था कसरी गर्छन् भनी सोधिएको छ। साथै भूर्भुवादि चौध भुवनहरूलाई प्रकाशित गर्दै पृथ्वीको परिक्रमा कसरी गर्छन् भनी पनि सोधिएको छ। पाण्डेयको अनुवादमा पनि यही अर्थ छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The question asks how the sun (taken as representative of all planets) produces the arrangement of day and night. It also asks how the sun circles the earth while illuminating the bhuvanas, the fourteen worlds from Bhur to Patala. Pandey's translation renders the verse in exactly these terms.

commentaries.ne:
सूर्य ग्रहहरूको प्रतिनिधि (उपलक्षण) भएकाले सूर्यलाई प्रश्न गरिएको हो। ग्रह पृथ्वीको वरिपरि घुम्छन् भन्ने मान्यता हो।
पौराणिक मतअनुसार पृथ्वी ऐनाजस्तो समतल हो, र यसको बीचमा मेरु छ। सूर्य मेरुको वरिपरि पृथ्वीमाथि घुम्दा आफूले देखिने भागमा दिन र नदेखिने भागमा रात हुन्छ। यो सबैलाई थाहा छ।
आपत्ति: यदि सूर्य पृथ्वीको वरिपरि घुम्छ भने तपाईंको मतमा दिन र रात बनाउने कुनै व्यवधायक (बीचमा आउने अवरोध) छैन। अन्य ग्रहहरूले पनि आफ्नो दिन र रात बनाउँछन्।
उत्तर: यदि पृथ्वीलाई व्यवधायक मानिन्छ र सूर्य त्यसको वरिपरि घुम्छ भने पृथ्वी नै दिन र रातको कारण हो। त्यसैले व्यवस्था ठीक छ।
दोस्रो प्रश्न: सूर्य पृथ्वीको वरिपरि कसरी घुम्छ? आधारविना पृथ्वी स्थिर रहन सक्दैन। यदि यसको आधार छ भने आधारले ग्रहहरूको पृथ्वीवरिपरिको भ्रमणलाई बाधा पुर्‍याउँछ। त्यसैले कथन विरोधी हुन्छ।
commentaries.en:
The question arises because the planets move around the earth, which is the support. The sun is asked about because it stands for all planets (upalakshana).
According to the account (the Puranic view), the earth is a mirror-like plane with Meru at its centre. The sun circling Meru above the earth makes day in the part that is visible and night in the part that is not. This is known to everyone.
Objection: if the sun circles the earth as you hold, what intervening obstruction (vyavadhayaka) makes day and night in your view? Other planets also make their own days and nights.
Answer: if the earth is taken as the obstruction, and the sun moves around it, then the earth itself is the cause of day and night, so the arrangement is correct.
Second question: how does the sun circle the earth? The earth cannot stay without support. If it has a support, the support blocks the planets from circling it. So the statement is contradicted.

commentaries.ne:
तत्त्वामृतले श्लोकको अर्थ यसरी बताएको छ: सूर्य ग्रहहरूको प्रकाशको स्वामी भगवान्को बिम्बरूप हो। सूर्यले दिन र रात बनाउँछ र भुवनहरूलाई प्रकाशित गर्दै पृथ्वीको परिक्रमा गर्छ।
पौराणिक मतमा पृथ्वी समतल छ र बीचमा मेरु छ। सूर्य मेरुको वरिपरि घुम्दा जहाँ देखिन्छ त्यहाँ दिन र जहाँ देखिँदैन त्यहाँ रात हुन्छ। त्यसैले देखिने र नदेखिने अवस्थाको कारण मेरु हो।
तपाईंको मतमा सूर्य घुम्दा देखिने र नदेखिने अवस्थाको कारण के हो? यदि सूर्य पृथ्वीको वरिपरि घुम्छ भने पृथ्वी नै देखिने र नदेखिने अवस्थाको कारण हो। पृथ्वी भारी छ। यदि यसलाई आधार छैन भने यो कसरी टिक्छ? यदि आधार छ भने आधारले सूर्यको घुमाइमा बाधा पुर्‍याउँछ।
यस प्रश्नको उत्तर श्लोक ४५-५० मा दिइएको छ।
commentaries.en:
Tattvamrita explains the verse: the sun is the disc-form of the lord (Bhagavan) of the light of the planets. It makes day and night and circles the earth while illuminating the worlds (bhuvanas).
In the Puranic view, the earth is a flat plane with Meru in the middle. The sun circling Meru makes day where it is seen and night where it is not seen. So the seeing and not seeing come from Meru.
In your view, what cause produces the seeing and not seeing when the sun moves? If the sun circles the earth, the earth is the cause of seeing and not seeing. The earth is heavy. If it has no support, how does it stay up? If it has a support, the support hinders the sun's movement around it.
The answer to this question is given in verses 45-50.

shlokas.sanskrit: देवासुराणामन्योन्यमहोरात्रविपर्ययात् । किमर्थं तत् कथं वा स्याद् भानोर्भगणपूरणात्
shlokas.meaning_ne: यस श्लोकमा देवता र असुरहरूका अहोरात्र व्यवस्था एकअर्कासँग किन र कसरी विपरीत हुन्छन् भन्ने प्रश्न छ। सूर्यले बाह्र राशि पार गरेर भगण पूरा गर्दा यिनीहरूको अहोरात्र कसरी बन्छ भन्ने पनि प्रश्न हो। यो श्लोक प्रश्न हो, र उत्तर पछिका श्लोकहरूमा छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: This verse asks why the day-night arrangements of gods and asuras are opposite to each other, and how they come about. It also asks how they arise from the completion of the sun's revolution through the twelve signs (bhagana). The verse is a question, and the answer follows in the later verses.

commentaries.ne:
यहाँ दुईवटा प्रश्न उल्टो क्रममा उठाइएको छ, देवता र असुरहरूका दिन-रात एकअर्कासँग विपरीत हुने बारेमा।
श्लोकको पूर्वार्ध पहिले नै व्याख्या गरिएको छ।
'किमर्थ' ले 'अहोरात्र' विशेषणमा रहेको अभिप्राय के हो भनी सोध्छ।
देवता र असुरहरूका दिन र रात किन एउटै भनिएन? किनभने विपर्ययलाई नियमन गर्ने कारण छैन।
'तत्' ले देवता र असुरहरूको अहोरात्र सूर्यको बाह्र राशि भोगबाट हुन्छ भन्ने जनाउँछ।
'कथं' ले कसरी र कुन कारणले भनी सोध्छ। 'वा' समुच्चय अर्थमा छ।
दुवै पक्षमा नियमन गर्ने कारण नभएकाले दुवैमा शंका उत्पन्न हुन्छ।
दिन र रात सूर्य देखिने वा नदेखिने कुराले निश्चित हुन्छ। जहाँ देवताले छ महिनासम्म सूर्य देख्छन्, त्यहाँ असुरले देख्दैनन्। जहाँ देवताले छ महिनासम्म देख्दैनन्, त्यहाँ असुरले देख्छन्।
लेखकले भगवानबाट यसको बोध गराउनुपर्ने भन्छन्।
commentaries.en:
The two questions are raised in reverse order, about the gods' and asuras' day-night being opposite to each other.
The first half of the verse was explained earlier.
'Kimartha' asks what the intention is behind the qualifier 'ahorātra'.
Why were the gods' and asuras' day and night not stated as identical? Because there is no regulating cause for the reversal.
'Tat' means that the gods' and asuras' day-night comes from the sun's progression through the twelve signs.
'Katham' asks how, and from what cause. 'Vā' is a conjunction meaning 'and'.
The doubt arises in both cases, since neither side has a regulating cause.
Day and night are fixed by whether the sun is seen or not seen. Where the gods see the sun for six months, the asuras do not see it. Where the gods do not see it for six months, the asuras see it.
The author says he should be taught this by the Lord.

commentaries.ne:
तत्त्वामृतले यो श्लोकलाई देवता र असुरहरूका दिन-रातमा छ महिनाको भिन्नता कसरी हुन्छ भन्ने प्रश्नका रूपमा लिन्छ।
पुराणले देवताको दिन असुरको रात हुन्छ भनेका छन्, र यसको कारण सोधिएको हो।
सूर्य आफ्नै गतिले पूर्वतर्फ घुम्दै बाह्र राशि (भगण) पूरा गर्दा यो भिन्नता कसरी बन्छ भन्ने प्रश्न गरिएको छ।
देवता र असुरहरूको अहोरात्र एक सौर वर्षबराबर कसरी हुन्छ भन्ने पनि सोधिएको छ।
त्यसैले देवताको दिन छ सौर मास र रात छ सौर मास कसरी हुन्छ भन्नु प्रश्नको सार हो।
'विपर्ययात्' भन्ने पद व्याख्या गरिएको छ: छ सौर माससम्म देवताले सूर्य देख्छन् र असुरले देख्दैनन्, अर्को आधामा उल्टो हुन्छ।
यसको कारण के हो भन्ने प्रश्न हो, र उत्तर श्लोक ४५ देखि ५० मा दिइएको छ।
commentaries.en:
The Tattvamrita takes the verse as a question about a six-month difference in day and night between gods and asuras.
The Puranas say that the gods' day is the asuras' night, and the reason for this is asked.
It asks how the sun, moving eastward by its own motion, completes the twelve signs (bhagana) and thereby produces this difference.
It asks how the day-night of gods and asuras can equal one solar year.
So the question is how the gods have a day of six solar months and a night of six solar months.
The phrase 'viparyayāt' is explained: for six solar months the gods see the sun, while the asuras do not, and the reverse holds in the other half.
The question is what cause produces this, and the answer is given in verses 45 to 50.

shlokas.sanskrit: पित्र्यं मासेन भवति नाडीषष्ट्या तु मानुषम् । तदेव किल सर्वत्र न भवेत् केन हेतुना
shlokas.meaning_ne: पितृहरूका दिन र रात एक चान्द्रमास बराबर हुन्छ, र मानिसहरूका दिन र रात साठी नाडी (घडी) हुन्छ। यही साठी घडीको दिन-रात सबै ठाउँमा किन हुँदैन, त्यसको कारण के हो भनी प्रश्न गरिएको छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The day and night of the pitṛs (manes) equal one lunar month, and the day and night of humans equal sixty nāḍīs (ghaṭīs). The verse then asks why this human day and night does not hold everywhere, and for what reason.

commentaries.ne:
पितृणामिदमहोरात्रम्: पितृहरूका दिन र रात। मासेन: दुबैतर्फ दर्श (औंसी) द्वारा सीमित एक चान्द्रमास।
केन हेतुना शब्दलाई दुवै वाक्यांशसँग जोडिन्छ: पितृ-दिन किन चान्द्रमास हो, र मानिसको दिन किन साठी सावन घडी हो।
तदेव भन्नाले साठी घडीको मानव दिन-रात हो; एव ले अरू कुनै पाठलाई निषेध गर्छ।
किल भन्नाले निश्चयपूर्वक हो; सर्वत्र भन्नाले देव, असुर र पितृ लोकसहित सबै लोकमा हो।
प्रश्न यो हो कि मानिसको यही दिन-रात सबै प्राणीहरूको दिन-रात किन हुँदैन।
आपत्ति: अघिल्लो श्लोकमा दिव्यं तदह उच्यते भनिएको छ तर पितृ र मानव दिन नाम लिइएको छैन, त्यसैले दुई प्रश्न जोडिँदैनन्। उत्तर: दिव्यं तदह उच्यते ले नै सावन दिन-रात र चान्द्रमास दिइसकेको छ, त्यसैले पितृ-दिन अर्थतः बताइएको छ।
आपत्ति: मानव दिन प्रत्यक्ष हुन्छ, त्यसैले प्रश्न आधारहीन छ। उत्तर: यो प्रश्न श्लोकहरूको तात्पर्य सोध्छ।
पितृ, देव र असुरका दिन प्रत्यक्ष हुँदैनन्, त्यसैले ती कसरी जनाइए? र प्रत्यक्ष मानव दिन तिनका लागि किन भनिएन?
commentaries.en:
pitṛṇām idam ahorātram: the day and night of the pitṛs. māsena: one lunar month, bounded by darśa (new moon) at both ends.
kena hetunā is read with each clause: why the pitṛ day is a lunar month, and why the human day is sixty sāvana ghaṭīs.
tad eva refers to the human day and night of sixty ghaṭīs; eva excludes any other reading.
kila means certainly; sarvatra means in all worlds, including the worlds of gods, asuras and pitṛs.
The question is why this human day and night is not the day and night of all beings.
Objection: the earlier verse said divyaṁ tad ahaḥ ucyate but did not name the pitṛ and human days, so the two questions do not connect. Answer: divyaṁ tad ahaḥ ucyate already gives the sāvana day and night and the lunar month, so the pitṛ day is implied.
Objection: the human day is directly perceived, so the question has no basis. Answer: the question asks for the purpose (tātparya) of the verses.
The days of the pitṛs, gods and asuras are not perceived, so how were they made known? And why was the perceived human day not stated for them?

commentaries.ne:
कपिलेश्वरले भन्छन् कि पितृहरू चन्द्रमण्डलमा बस्छन्, र तिनीहरूको दिन चान्द्रमास हो। स्क्यानमा बिग्रिएको उनको पाठअनुसार तिनीहरूको दिन कृष्णपक्षको सप्तमीदेखि शुक्लपक्षको सप्तमीसम्म र रात त्यसपछिका पन्ध्र तिथि हो।
मानव दिन-रात साठी सावन घडीका हुन्छन्, र तदह्नोरात्र भन्नाले यही मानव दिन हो।
सर्वत्र भन्नाले देव, असुर र पितृ लोकहरूमा हो।
यो विद्यार्थीको आपत्ति हो: मानव दिन सबै प्राणीका लागि किन उस्तै हुँदैन?
commentaries.en:
Kapileshwar says the pitṛs live in the lunar sphere, and their day is the lunar month. His text (damaged in the scan) gives their day from the seventh tithi of the dark half to the seventh tithi of the bright half, and their night as the fifteen tithis that follow.
Human day and night are the sixty sāvana ghaṭīs, and tad-ahorātra refers to this human day.
sarvatra means in the worlds of gods, asuras and pitṛs.
The question is a student's objection: why is the human day not the same for all beings?

commentaries.ne: मिश्रको हिन्दी टीकाले प्रश्न फराकिलो बनाउँछ: दिन, वर्ष, मास र होराका अधिपति किन एउटै ढाँचाका हुँदैनन्, जसरी पितृ र मानव दिन-रात फरक हुन्छन्।
commentaries.en: Mishra's Hindi tika widens the question: why do the day, year, month and hora lords not follow one pattern, just as the day-night of the pitṛs and humans differ.

shlokas.sanskrit: दिनाब्दमासहोराणामधिपा न समाः कुतः । कथं पर्येति भगणः सग्रहोऽयं किमाश्रयः
shlokas.meaning_ne: दिन, वर्ष, मास र होराका अधिपति किन समान हुँदैनन्? ग्रहसहितको यो नक्षत्रचक्र कसरी घुम्छ, र यसको आधार के हो? श्लोकले दिन, वर्ष, मास र होराका स्वामी किन फरक छन्, नक्षत्र र ग्रहसहितको चक्र कसरी घुम्छ, र त्यसलाई कुन आधारले थामेको छ भनी सोध्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Why are the lords of the day, year, month and hora not the same? How does this star-sphere, together with the planets, revolve, and what is its support? The verse asks why the lords of these time units differ, how the star-sphere with its planets moves, and what holds it up.

commentaries.ne:
प्रश्न दिन, वर्ष, मास र होराका स्वामीबारे हो, जुन अहर्गणबाट पत्ता लाग्छ। दिन, मास र वर्षका स्वामी थाहा पाएपछि लेखकले होराका स्वामीबारे सोध्छन्, किनकि त्यो पहिले भनिएको थिएन।
यो प्रश्न गरिएको हो किनभने जातक (ज्योतिष) मा होराका स्वामी धेरै प्रसिद्ध छन्, यद्यपि पहिले त्यो भनिएको थिएन।
पहिलो प्रश्न: दिनका स्वामी सूर्य र अन्य ग्रहको क्रममा आउँछन्, त्यसैगरी पहिलो मास र वर्षका स्वामी पनि त्यही क्रममा हुनुपर्ने हो, तब किन समान हुँदैनन्?
दोस्रो प्रश्न: भगण भनेको नक्षत्रसमूह हो; सग्रह भनेको ग्रहसहित हो।
ग्रहसहितको यो नक्षत्रचक्र कसरी र कुन प्रकारले घुम्छ, जब नक्षत्र र ग्रह पृथ्वीको वरिपरि घुमिरहेका छन्?
यसको आधार के हो? आधार बिना आकाशमा यसको स्थिति सम्भव छैन।
commentaries.en:
The question is about the lords of the day, year, month and hora, which are found from the ahargana. Having established the lords of day, month and year, the author now asks about the lord of the hora, since the hora lord was not stated before.
The question is asked because the hora lord is well known in jātaka (astrology), even though it was not given earlier.
The first question: why are the lords of day, year, month and hora not the same, when the lords of the days follow the order of the Sun and the other planets, the same order should apply to the first month and year.
The second question: bhagaṇa means the group of stars; sagraha means together with the planets.
How does this star-sphere together with the planets move, and by what means, when the stars and planets are moved around the earth?
What is its support? Without a support, its position in the air is impossible.

commentaries.ne:
प्रश्न दिन, वर्ष, मास र होराका स्वामी किन समान छैनन् भनी हो। हप्ताका वारका स्वामी (सूर्य र अन्य ग्रह क्रमशः) जस्तै, पहिलो मास र वर्षका स्वामी पनि त्यही क्रममा हुनुपर्ने हो, तर छैनन्। कारण विधिमा छ: मास र वर्षका स्वामी दिनको गणनाबाट अर्को नियमले निकालिन्छ, जसको विधि भएको श्लोक उद्धृत गरिएको छ, त्यसैले तिनीहरू वारको क्रम पछ्याउँदैनन्।
होराका स्वामी पहिले सिकाइएको थिएन, तर प्रश्न सान्दर्भिक छ, किनभने जातकमा होराका स्वामी धेरै प्रसिद्ध छन्।
सग्रह भनेको ग्रहसहित हो। भगण भनेको नक्षत्रसमूह, अर्थात् नक्षत्रचक्र हो। किमाश्रय भनेको यो कुन आधारमा टिकेको छ भन्ने हो।
यो कसरी घुम्छ? यदि आधार बिना आकाशमा चारैतिर घुमिरहेको छ भने, यो अन्तरिक्षमा कसरी टिक्छ? र यदि आधार छ भने, त्यसको वरिपरि यो कसरी घुम्छ?
commentaries.en:
The question asks why the lords of day, year, month and hora are not equal. Like the weekday lords (Sun and the other planets in order), the lords of the first month and year should also follow that order, but they do not. The reason lies in the method: the lords of months and years are found by a separate rule from the day count, a verse on that method being quoted, so they do not follow the weekday sequence.
The hora lord was not taught earlier, but the question is relevant, since the hora lord is well known in jātaka.
Sagraha means with the planets. Bhagaṇa means the group of stars, the star-sphere. Kimāśraya means: on what support is it resting?
How does it revolve? If something revolves all around the sky without any support, how can it remain in space? And if it has a support, how does it turn all round it?

commentaries.ne: मिश्रको हिन्दी टीकाले प्रश्नलाई फेरि भन्छ: भगण ग्रहसहित कुन प्रकारले घुम्छ र यसको आधार के हो। त्यसपछिको संस्कृत अंशले कक्षा (कक्ष) नै आधार हुन् भन्ने आपत्ति उठाउँछ, पहिलेको वसु, मरुत र गंगाबारेको कथनलाई उद्धृत गर्दै; अंश त्यहीँ टुटेको छ।
commentaries.en: Mishra's Hindi tika restates the question: in what manner the bhagaṇa, together with the planets, moves about, and what is its support. The Sanskrit fragment that follows opens an objection that the orbits (kakṣā) themselves are the supports, citing an earlier statement about the Vasus, Maruts and Ganga; the excerpt breaks off there.

shlokas.sanskrit: भूमेरुपर्युपर्यूर्ध्वाः किमुत्सेधाः किमन्तराः । ग्रहर्क्षकक्षाः किमात्राः स्थिताः केन क्रमेण ताः
shlokas.meaning_ne: यस श्लोकमा ग्रह र नक्षत्रका कक्षाका बारेमा चार प्रश्न सोधिएका छन्। पृथ्वीभन्दा माथि एक-माथि अर्को गरी प्रत्येक कक्षा कति उचाइमा छ? तिनका बीचको अन्तराल कति हो? तिनको मात्रा अर्थात् आकार वा परिमाण कति हो? र कुन क्रमले कुन पहिले र कुन पछि राखिएका छन्?
shlokas.meaning_en: The verse asks four questions about the orbits (kakṣā) of the planets and the asterisms. How high is each orbit above the earth, one above another? What intervals lie between them? What is their measure or size? And in what order are they placed, which first and which next?

commentaries.ne:
पहिलेको श्लोकले कक्षाहरू आधार हुन् र प्रत्येक ग्रह आफ्नै मार्गमा चल्छ भनेकाले, कक्षाका बारेमा चार भागमा प्रश्न राखिएको हो।
उत्सेध: पृथ्वीबाट आकाशमा ग्रह र नक्षत्रका कक्षा कति माथि छन्, अर्थात् तिनको उचाइ (उच्चता)।
अन्तर: प्रत्येक कक्षा पृथ्वीबाट कति टाढा छ, र प्रत्येक कक्षा माथि वा तल्लो अर्को कक्षाबाट कति अन्तरमा छ।
मात्रा: तिनको परिमाण, अर्थात् तिनको रूप वा आकार (स्वरूप, प्रमाण)।
क्रम: कुन कक्षा पहिले, कुन अर्को, तिनको अनुक्रम कस्तो छ; यो क्रम थाहा छैन।
commentaries.en:
Since the earlier verse says the orbits are the supports and each planet moves along its own path, the question is put in four parts about the orbits.
Utsedha: how high above the earth the orbits of the planets and asterisms lie in the sky, that is their height (uccatā).
Antara: how far each orbit lies from the earth, and how far apart each is from the next higher or lower one.
Mātrā: their measure, that is their form or size (svarūpa, pramāṇa).
Krama: which orbit is first, which comes next, in what sequence they are placed; this order is not known.

commentaries.ne:
कपिलेश्वरले कक्षालाई प्रत्येक ग्रह र नक्षत्रको कक्षा, अर्थात् तिनले चल्ने मार्ग मानेका छन्।
उत्सेध: पृथ्वीबाट क्रमशः माथि-माथि रहेका प्रत्येक कक्षाको उचाइ (उच्चता) कति छ।
अन्तर: पृथ्वीबाट प्रत्येक कक्षा र माथि-तल्लो कक्षाहरूका बीच कति दूरी छ।
मात्रा: प्रत्येक कक्षा कति ठूलो छ, अर्थात् तिनको परिमाण (प्रमाण) कति हो।
क्रम: कक्षाहरू कुन क्रमले छन्, कुन पहिले र कुन पछि आउँछ; यो अनुक्रमको प्रश्न हो।
commentaries.en:
Kapileshwar explains kakṣā as the orbit of each planet and asterisk, the path on which it moves.
Utsedha: each orbit, arranged successively higher from the earth, has a stated height (uccatā).
Antara: how much distance lies between each orbit and the earth, and between each upper and lower orbit.
Mātrā: how large each orbit is, its measure (pramāṇa).
Krama: in what order the orbits stand, which is first and which comes after; this is the question of sequence.

shlokas.sanskrit: ग्रीष्मे तीव्रकरो भानुर्न हेमन्ते तथाविधः । कियती तत्करप्राप्तिर्मानानि कति किञ्चतैः
shlokas.meaning_ne: यस श्लोकमा तीनवटा प्रश्न छन्। ग्रीष्ममा सूर्यका किरण तीव्र हुन्छन्, तर हेमन्तमा त्यस्तो हुँदैन। सूर्यका किरण कति टाढासम्म पुग्छन्? तिनका आधारमा कति प्रकारका मान (कालमान) छन्, र तिनको प्रयोजन के हो? पाण्डेय र मिश्र दुवैले यसरी अर्थ गरेका छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: The verse asks three questions. In summer the sun has intense rays, but in winter it is not of that kind. How far do the sun's rays reach? How many time-measures (mānas) are there, based on them, and what is their purpose? Pandey and Mishra both read it this way.

commentaries.ne:
- श्लोकले सूर्यको अवस्था र सूर्यका किरणसम्बन्धी प्रश्न उठाउँछ, जुन पहिले भनिएका कालमानको चर्चापछि आएको छ।
- प्रश्न १: ग्रीष्म ऋतुमा सूर्य किन तीक्ष्ण (तीव्र किरण भएको) हुन्छ, तर हेमन्तमा किन हुँदैन।
- प्रश्न २: सूर्यका किरण कति दूरीसम्म पुग्छन् र आकाशमा कति टाढासम्म फैलिन्छन्।
- प्रश्न ३: पहिले भनिएका नाक्षत्र, सावन, चान्द्र, सौर आदि कति प्रकारका मान छन्, र तिनको प्रयोजन के हो।
- टीकाले भन्छ, पहिलेको उपक्रममा मानहरू संक्षेपमा मात्र भनिएका थिए, त्यसैले तिनको तत्त्व पूर्ण रूपमा थाहा भएन। प्रश्नले पूर्ण विवरण माग्छ।
- च शब्द समुच्चयार्थक हो र यो तीनै प्रश्नसँग जोडिन्छ।
commentaries.en:
- The verse opens a question on the state of the sun, and on the sun's rays, which follows from the earlier discussion of time-measures.
- Question 1: why the sun is fierce (tīkṣṇa-kiraṇa, hot-rayed) in the hot season but not in the winter (hemanta).
- Question 2: how far the sun's rays travel (prāpti, gamana-paddhati) and to what extent in the sky.
- Question 3: how many time-measures there are (nākṣatra, sāvana, cāndra, saura and others, stated earlier) and what they are for.
- The commentary explains that the earlier introduction gave only a brief outline of the measures, so the author did not fully know their nature. The question asks for a full account.
- The particle ca is a samuccaya (conjunction) and is joined to each of the three questions.

commentaries.ne: तत्त्वामृतले श्लोकलाई सूर्यको अवस्था र कालमानसम्बन्धी प्रश्नको रूपमा परिचय दिन्छ। 'ग्रीष्मे' भन्नाले ज्येष्ठादि गर्मी महिना भनिएको छ, र माघादि जाडो महिनामा सूर्य किन त्यस्तो तीक्ष्ण हुँदैन भनेर सोधिएको छ। आकाशमा सूर्यका किरण कति टाढासम्म फैलिन्छन्, र सावन, सौर, चान्द्र आदि पहिले भनिएका मान कति छन् र तिनको प्रयोजन के हो भन्ने प्रश्न पनि उठाइएको छ। पहिले उपक्रममा मानहरू भनिए पनि पूर्ण ज्ञानका लागि प्रश्न फेरि दोहोर्याइएको हो भनिएको छ।
commentaries.en: Kapileshwar's Tattvamrita introduces the verse as a question on the sun's state and time-measures. It explains 'grīṣme' as the hot months (jyeṣṭha and others) and asks why the sun is not similarly fierce in the winter months (māgha and others). It asks how far in the sky the sun's rays spread, and how many time-measures there are (sāvana, saura, cāndra and others mentioned earlier) and what they are for. It notes that even though the measures were introduced earlier, the question is repeated so that they may be fully understood.

shlokas.sanskrit: एवं मे संशयं छिन्धि भगवन् भूतभावन । अन्यो न त्वामृते छेत्ता विद्यते सर्वदर्शिवान्
shlokas.meaning_ne: माया सूर्यलाई भगवान् र भूत, वर्तमान तथा भविष्य जान्ने भनी सम्बोधन गर्छन् र आफ्ना संशयहरू हटाइदिन अनुरोध गर्छन्। सबै कुरा देख्ने सूर्यबाहेक अरू कसैले यी संशय हटाउन सक्दैन भनी उनी भन्छन्। यो श्लोकले मायाले सूर्यलाई गरेको प्रश्नको उपसंहार गर्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: Maya addresses the Sun as the Lord and the one who knows the past, present and future, and asks him to remove his doubts. He says that no one other than the Sun, the all-seeing one, is able to remove them. The verse closes the question-and-answer that Maya has put to the Sun.

commentaries.ne:
- 'भगवान्' भन्नाले छवटा ऐश्वर्य भएको व्यक्ति हो; 'सर्वबोधक' भन्ने तात्पर्य सम्बोधनमा निहित छ।
- 'भूतभावन' भन्नाले जसको भूत कालको भावना (विचार) छ, त्यस्तो व्यक्ति हो; अर्थात् उसले वर्तमान र भविष्य काल पनि जान्छ।
- 'मे' भन्नाले 'मम' (मेरो) हो। 'एतम्' भनेको भर्खरै भनिएको संशय हो। 'संशयम्' एकवचन जातिको अभिप्रायमा प्रयोग भएको हो, अर्थात् मैले उठाएका संशयहरू।
- 'छिन्धि' भन्नाले 'छेदय' (हटाउनुहोस्) हो।
- शंका: 'म अहिले भनिएकै कुरा मात्र भन्न सक्छु; त्यसोभए अरू संशय किन हटाउनुहुन्छ?'
- उत्तर: 'अन्यः' (अरू कोही) भन्नाले 'सर्वदर्शिवान्' अर्थात् सबै देख्ने, सर्वज्ञ, भन्ने हो। 'छेत्ता' भनेको संशय हटाउने हो। 'न विद्यते' भनेको छैन। 'त्वामृते' भनेको तपाईंबिना हो।
- अतः अर्थ यो हो: यहाँसम्म सोधिएको कुरा तपाईंले भन्नुभयो; कृपा गरेर बाँकी कुरा पनि भन्नुहोस्।
commentaries.en:
- 'Bhagavan' means one who possesses the six opulences; 'sarvabodhaka' is the implied sense of the address.
- 'Bhūtabhāvana' means one whose contemplation (bhāvanā, vichāra) extends over past time; by implication he also knows present and future time.
- 'Me' means 'mama' (my). 'Etam' refers to the doubt just stated. 'Saṃśayam' is the singular used in a generic sense (jātyabhiprāya), so it means the doubts raised by me.
- 'Chhindhi' means 'chhedaya' (remove).
- Objection: 'I cannot now speak of anything beyond what has been said; so why should you remove my other doubts?'
- Answer: 'Anyaḥ' (no other) refers to the one who is 'sarvadarśivān', i.e. all-seeing, meaning all-knowing. 'Chhettā' is the remover of doubts. 'Na vidyate' means does not exist. 'Tvāmṛte' means without you.
- So the meaning is: up to this point you have told what was asked; out of grace, please also tell the rest.

commentaries.ne:
- सूर्यलाई सूर्यकै अंशबाट साक्षात् उत्पन्न र आकाशको शक्ति भएको मानिएको छ (साक्षात् सूर्यांशखमुद्भूतत्वात्, खशक्तिमान्)।
- 'भूतभावन' भन्नाले जसको लागि सम्पूर्ण पदार्थहरूको भावना अर्थात् विवेचन उपस्थित छ, त्यस्तो व्यक्ति हो।
- 'मे' भन्नाले 'मम' हो, अर्थात् तपाईंको शिष्यका रूपमा शरण पर्न आएको म। 'एतम्' भनेको भनिएको हो। 'संशयम्' भनेको सन्देह हो।
- एकवचन जातिको अभिप्रायमा प्रयोग भएको हो। 'छेदय' भनेको हटाउनु हो।
- अर्थ यो हो: सत्य उत्तरद्वारा मेरा सन्देह हटाउनुहोस्।
- तपाईंबाहेक अरू कोही पनि विविध विषयका विवेचक (विविध विषयक विवेचक) छैनन् जसले मेरा संशय हटाउन सकून्। तपाईं मात्र सर्वज्ञ हुनुहुन्छ जसले मेरा सन्देह हटाउन सक्नुहुन्छ; त्यसैले तपाईंले नै हटाउनुहोस्।
commentaries.en:
- The Sun is taken as an incarnation of a portion of the Sun itself (sākṣāt sūryāṃśa) and as one who possesses the power of the sky (khaśaktimān).
- 'Bhūtabhāvana' means the one for whom the contemplation (vivecana) of all existing things (nikhila-padārtha) is present.
- 'Me' means 'mama', i.e. the speaker as one who has taken refuge as a pupil of the Sun. 'Etam' means 'the stated'. 'Saṃśayam' means doubt.
- The singular is used in a generic sense (jātyabhiprāyika). 'Chhedaya' means remove.
- The sense is: remove my doubts by giving true answers.
- No one other than you is a discriminator of diverse subjects (vividha-viṣayaka-vivecaka) who can be a remover (nivāraka) of my doubts. You alone are the all-knowing one able to remove my doubts; remove them.

shlokas.sanskrit: इति भक्त्योदितं श्रुत्वा मयोक्तं वाक्यमस्य हि । रहस्यं परमाध्यायं ततः प्राह पुनः स तम्
shlokas.meaning_ne: भक्तिपूर्वक भनिएका मयका वचन सुनेर सूर्यांश पुरुषले पूर्वार्धमा भनिएका ग्रहगतिपछि ग्रन्थको उत्तरवर्ती परम रहस्यमय अध्याय फेरि भन्नुभयो। पूर्वार्धका कुरा नै गोप्य तत्त्व भएकाले यो उत्तरखण्ड पनि त्यसैगरी सिकाइयो।
shlokas.meaning_en: Having heard Maya's words, spoken with devotion, the Sun's-portion Purusha again told Maya the supreme secret chapter, the later part of the text, after the earlier account of planetary motion. The earlier part of the work is itself a secret, so this continuation is taught as its essential truth.

commentaries.ne:
इति भन्नाले सूर्यांश पुरुष भन्ने अघि उल्लेख भएको वक्ता बुझिन्छ।
भक्त्या भन्नाले ज्ञानद्वारा आराधना गरेर भन्ने अर्थ हुन्छ।
उदितम् भन्नाले उत्पन्न भएको वा भनिएको भन्ने अर्थ हुन्छ।
मयले भनेका कुरा सुनेर, ध्यानपूर्वक सुनेर भन्ने अर्थ हो।
पुनः भन्नाले दोस्रो पटक हो: पूर्वार्धको शिक्षापछि उनले मयासुरलाई परम दोस्रो अध्याय भने।
यो ग्रन्थको उत्तरखण्ड हो।
पूर्वखण्ड निश्चय नै गोप्य भएकाले यसको तत्त्व स्पष्टसँग भने।
commentaries.en:
Iti refers to the Sun's-portion Purusha, the speaker mentioned earlier.
Bhaktyā means by worshipping with knowledge.
Udita means arisen or uttered.
Having heard the words spoken by Maya, having listened attentively.
Punar means a second time: after the first half of the teaching, he addressed Maya again with the supreme second chapter.
This is the later part of the text.
Because the earlier part of the text is certainly a secret, he declared its essential truth clearly.

commentaries.ne:
इति भन्नाले अघि भनिएको सूर्यांश पुरुष हो।
भक्त्या भन्नाले सेवा गर्ने वस्तुका रूपमा ज्ञान देखाउनु हो।
मयोक्तम् भन्नाले मय असुरले भनेका वचन हुन्।
तम् भन्नाले सच्चा शिष्यका रूपमा आएको मय असुर हो, जसको भक्ति देखिएको थियो।
ततः भन्नाले पूर्वार्धको कथनपछि फेरि भन्ने अर्थ हो।
रहस्य भन्नाले ज्योतिष ज्ञानको परम गोप्य कुरा हो।
परम अध्याय भन्नाले उत्तरार्धको रूप हो।
प्राह भन्नाले सत्य रूपमा र पूरा विवरणसहित भने भन्ने अर्थ हो।
राम्रो शिष्य र भक्तलाई गोप्य शिक्षा पनि दिन सकिन्छ, त्यसैले भगवानले सबै कुरा छुटाएनन्।
commentaries.en:
Iti means the aforementioned Sun's-portion Purusha.
Bhaktyā is glossed as showing knowledge as the object of service.
Mayoktam means the words spoken by Maya the Asura.
Tam means Maya, whom he recognised as a worthy disciple, and seeing the devotion Maya had directed towards him.
Tataḥ means again, after the statement of the first half.
Rahasyam means the supreme secret of the astronomical knowledge.
Param adhyāyam means the later half of the text.
Prāha means he told it truly and in full detail.
A good disciple and a devotee may be given even secret teaching, so the Lord taught him everything without omission.

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रृणुष्वैकमना भूत्वा गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् । प्रवक्ष्याम्यतिभक्तानां नादेयं विद्यते मम
shlokas.meaning_ne: सूर्याशपुरुषले मयलाई एकाग्र मनले सुन्न भन्छन्। उनी गुप्त अध्यात्मसंज्ञक ज्ञान सुनाउने भन्छन्, किनभने उनका अति भक्तहरूका लागि उनीसँग नदिइने केही पनि छैन।
shlokas.meaning_en: The Sun-Purusha tells Maya to listen with a single, undivided mind. He will reveal the secret teaching called adhyatma. He has nothing that he would withhold from his very devoted followers.

commentaries.ne:
सूर्याशपुरुषले मयलाई आफूले भनेको कुरा ध्यान दिएर सुन्न भन्छन्।
अति भक्त, विनम्र र उनको सेवा गर्ने व्यक्तिहरू (जस्तै मय) का लागि सूर्याशपुरुषबाट नदिइने केही छैन।
त्यसैले उनले मयलाई अध्यात्म भनिने गुप्त ज्ञान सुनाउँछन्।
एकमनाः: आफ्नो मन केवल उनका वचन सुन्नमा लगाएर।
श्रृणुष्व: कानलाई माध्यम बनाएर, आत्माको मनलाई सुनाइसँग जोडेर सुन्नू, ताकि मयले त्यसलाई प्रत्यक्ष बुझून्।
commentaries.en:
The Sun-Purusha tells Maya to listen carefully to what he says.
Because for those who are very devoted, humble and serve him, such as Maya, nothing is undeliverable by him, the Sun-Purusha.
Therefore he will tell Maya the secret knowledge called adhyatma.
Ekamanāḥ: having the mind fixed on hearing his words alone.
Śṛṇuṣva: listen through the ear-channel, joining the self's mind to hearing, so that Maya perceives it directly.

commentaries.ne:
अध्याय र यसको महिमा व्याख्या गरिने कुरा परिचय दिइएको छ। सूर्याशपुरुषबाट आफ्ना भक्तहरूका लागि नदिइने केही छैन, जो अति भक्त, विनम्र र उनको सेवा गर्ने हुन्। उनी आफ्ना भक्तहरूलाई सबै कुरा दिन्छन्, त्यसैले मयलाई गुप्त ज्ञान सुनाउँछन्। त्यसपछिको उपदेश यसैबारे हो।
एकमनाः: उनका वचन सुन्नमा मात्र मन लगाएको।
श्रृणुष्व: कान नामक इन्द्रियबाट, त्यसमा आत्मा लगाएर सुन।
commentaries.en:
Introduces the glory of the chapter that is to be expounded. Since nothing is undeliverable by the Sun-Purusha for his devotees, who are very devoted, humble and serve him, he gives everything to his devotees. Therefore he tells the secret knowledge to Maya; the teaching that follows is about this.
Ekamanāḥ: the mind is fixed on hearing his words alone.
Śṛṇuṣva: listen through the ear-organ, with the self engaged in it.

shlokas.sanskrit: वासुदेव: पर ब्रह्म तन्मूर्त्ति: पुरुष: पर: । अव्यक्तो निर्गुण: शान्त: पञ्चविंशात् परोऽव्यय:
shlokas.meaning_ne: वासुदेव परब्रह्म हुन्। तिनका मूर्ति परम पुरुष हुन्। तिनी अव्यक्त, निर्गुण, शान्त र पच्चीस तत्वभन्दा पर छन्, अर्थात् अविनाशी र निर्विकार छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Vāsudeva is the supreme Brahman. His form is the supreme Puruṣa. He is unmanifest, without qualities, calm, beyond the twenty-five categories, and imperishable, that is, free from change.

commentaries.ne:
'गुह्यं वक्ष्यामि' भनेर भनिएको गोप्य विषय अब भनिएको छ।
वासुदेव शब्दको व्युत्पत्ति: 'वसति अस्मिन् जगत् समस्तम्' (यसमा सम्पूर्ण जगत् बस्छ) वा 'असौ वा जगति समस्ते वसति' (उनी सम्पूर्ण जगत्मा बस्छन्)। वस् धातुमा ण्यन्त प्रत्यय लाग्दा 'वासु' बन्छ। 'देवनाद् भासनाद्वा' (चम्कनाले वा प्रकाशित हुनाले) 'देव' बन्छ। दुवै मिलेर 'वासुदेव' हुन्छ।
उद्धरण: 'सर्वत्रासौ समस्तं च वसत्यत्रेति वै यतः। अतोऽसौ वासुदेवाख्यो विद्वद्भिः परिगीयते॥'
'वसुदेवस्यापत्यम्' (वसुदेवका छोरा) भन्ने विग्रह यहाँ लागू हुँदैन, किनभने जगत्को कारणता निरूपण गर्ने प्रसङ्गमा त्यो उपयोगी छैन।
हाम्रो मतमा उहाँ उपादानको रूपमा जगत्को कारण हुनुहुन्छ, अर्थात् कार्य जसमा आधारित छ, वा उपादानले कार्यमा अनुस्यूत भएर रहेको रूपमा। 'ईशावास्यमिदं सर्वम्' (ईशावास्य उपनिषद्) र भागवतको 'अजनि च यन्मयं तदविमुच्यमियं नृभवेत्' उदाहरणका रूपमा दिइएका छन्।
पर भनेको सर्वोत्तम हो, किनभने जीवहरू पनि ब्रह्मस्वरूप छन्। गीताको 'यस्मात् क्षरमतीतोऽहम्' श्लोक उद्धृत छ।
तन्मूर्ति भनेको उहाँ वासुदेवको मूर्ति वा अंश हो। यो विशेषण अर्को श्लोकमा आउने सङ्कर्षणलाई पनि लागू हुन्छ। 'चिन्मूर्ति' पाठ प्रमादजन्य (गलत) हो।
'वासुदेवः सङ्कर्षणः' भन्ने अर्थ अभीष्ट होइन, अर्थात् वासुदेवबाट सङ्कर्षण भन्ने अर्थ होइन।
अव्यक्त भनेको इन्द्रियबाट अगोचर। 'न तं विदाथ य इमा जजान' भन्ने श्रुति उद्धृत छ।
निर्गुण अव्यक्त हुनुको कारण हो: संसारमा गुणयुक्त वस्तु मात्र देखिन्छ, त्यसैले गुणरहित उहाँ अव्यक्त हुनुहुन्छ। यसको अर्थ सत्त्व, रजस् र तमस् गुणबाट रहित भन्ने हो।
शान्त भनेको षड्ऊर्मि (भोक, प्यास, शोक, मोह, जरा र मृत्यु) बाट रहित।
पञ्चविंशात् परः: सोह्र विकृति, सात प्रकृति-विकृति र मूल प्रकृति मिलेर चौबिस तत्व हुन्छन्। पच्चीसौँ जीव हो, र उहाँ त्यसभन्दा पर हुनुहुन्छ।
अव्यय भनेको नाश र क्षयबाट रहित, अर्थात् नित्य।
'पञ्चविंशात्मक' पाठ मानिएमा अर्थ 'जगदात्मक' हुन्छ।
commentaries.en:
The secret promised earlier is now stated.
Etymology of Vāsudeva: in him the whole world dwells (vasati asmin jagat samastam), or he dwells in the whole world; from the root vas with the suffix ṇi comes vāsu. From devana (shining) or bhāsana (illumination) comes deva. Together they form Vāsudeva.
Quoted verse: 'sarvatrāsau samastaṃ ca vasaty atreti vai yataḥ; ato 'sau vāsudevākhyo viddhdbhiḥ parigīyate.'
The analysis 'vasudevasya apatyam' (son of Vasudeva) does not apply, because it is not useful in explaining the causation of the world.
In our view, he is the cause of the world either as its material substrate (upādāna), in which the effect rests, or as the material cause pervading the effect. The Īśāvāsya Upaniṣad ('īśāvāsyam idaṃ sarvam') and the Bhāgavata ('ajani ca yan mayaṃ tad avimucyam iyaṃ nṛbhaved') are cited.
Para means supreme, because the jīvas too are of Brahman's nature. The Gītā verse 'yasmāt kṣaram atīto 'ham' is quoted.
Tanmūrti means his form or part (aṃśa). This epithet also applies to Saṅkarṣaṇa, described in the next verse. The reading 'cinmūrti' is a scribal error.
The sense 'Saṅkarṣaṇa from Vāsudeva' is not the intended meaning.
Avyakta means beyond the senses. The Ṛg-type passage 'na taṃ vidātha ya imā jajāna…' is quoted.
Nirguṇa is the reason for being unmanifest: only qualified things are perceived in the world, so the unqualified one is unmanifest. It means free from sattva, rajas and tamas.
Śānta means free from the six waves (ṣaḍūrmi: hunger, thirst, grief, delusion, old age, death).
Pañcaviṃśāt paraḥ: sixteen modifications, seven prakṛti-vikṛtis and the root prakṛti make twenty-four tattvas. The twenty-fifth is the jīva, and he is beyond it.
Avyaya means free from destruction and decay, that is, eternal.
If the reading is 'pañcaviṃśātmaka', the sense becomes 'jagadātmaka'.

commentaries.ne:
तत्त्वामृतका अनुसार श्लोक १२ मा ब्रह्म 'बृंहति' (बढ्छ, फैलिन्छ) भएकाले ब्रह्म भनिन्छ। 'पर' भनेको सर्वोत्कृष्ट हो, किनभने जीवहरू पनि ब्रह्मस्वरूप छन्। 'तन्मूर्ति' भनेको त्यही परब्रह्म वासुदेवको अंश हो। 'पर पुरुष' भनेको प्रधान पुरुष, अर्थात् पुरुषोत्तम हो। अव्यक्त भनेको इन्द्रियबाट नदेखिने हो। गीताको 'यस्मात् क्षरमतीतोऽहम्' श्लोक र 'न तं विदाथ…' श्रुति उद्धृत छन्।
निर्गुण भनेको सत्त्व, रजस् र तमस्बाट रहित। शान्त भनेको कामादि र षड्ऊर्मिबाट पूर्ण रूपमा रहित। पञ्चविंशात् परः: सोह्र विकृति, सात प्रकृति-विकृति र एक मूल प्रकृति मिलेर चौबिस तत्व हुन्छन्। पच्चीसौँ जीव हो, र उहाँ त्यसभन्दा पर हुनुहुन्छ। अव्यय भनेको नाश र क्षयबाट रहित, अर्थात् नित्य।
आपत्ति: यदि उहाँ ब्रह्मरूप हुनुहुन्छ भने जगत्को कारण कसरी हुनुहुन्छ? यसको उत्तर श्लोक १३ मा 'प्रकृत्यन्तर्गतः' भनेर दिइएको छ।
तत्त्वामृतले 'वासुदेवस्यापत्यं पुमान् वासुदेवः' भन्ने व्युत्पत्ति पनि दिन्छ, जसले कृष्णतिर संकेत गर्छ (भागवत: 'कृष्णस्तु भगवान् स्वयम्')। तर कृष्णको पछिको अवतार जगत्-कारणताको वर्णनमा आवश्यक नभएकाले त्यो अस्वीकार गरिन्छ, र पहिलो व्युत्पत्ति उत्तम मानिन्छ। 'वासु' भनेको स्वयं चम्कने (भासते) हो; 'देव' भनेको विश्वव्यापक, विभु हो।
commentaries.en:
Tattvamrita on verse 12: Brahman is so called because it is vast (bṛṃhati). 'Para' signals the highest, since the jīvas too are Brahman in nature. 'Tanmūrti' means the aṃśa of that supreme Brahman Vāsudeva. 'Para puruṣa' means the principal Puruṣa, Puruṣottama. Avyakta means imperceptible. The Gītā ('yasmāt kṣaram atīto 'ham') and the Ṛg-type passage ('na taṃ vidātha…') are quoted.
Nirguṇa means free from sattva, rajas and tamas. Śānta means wholly calm, free from desire and the other six waves. Pañcaviṃśāt paraḥ: sixteen vikṛtis, seven prakṛti-vikṛtis and the single root prakṛti make twenty-four tattvas; the twenty-fifth is the jīva, and he is beyond it. Avyaya means free from destruction and decay, that is, eternal.
Objection: if he is of the form of Brahman, how can he be the cause of creation? The answer is given in verse 13 ('prakṛtyantargataḥ').
Kapileshwar also gives the derivation 'vasudevasyāpatyaṃ pumān vāsudevaḥ', which would point to Kṛṣṇa (Bhāgavata: 'kṛṣṇas tu bhagavān svayam'). He rejects it, because Kṛṣṇa's later appearance is not needed in the account of cosmic causation. The first derivation is preferred. Vāsu is 'one who shines (bhāsate) by itself'; deva means all-pervading and all-powerful, the vibhu.

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रकृत्यन्तर्गतो देवो बहिरन्तश्च सर्वगः । सङ्कर्षणोऽपः सृष्ट्वादौ तासु वीर्यमवासृजत्
shlokas.meaning_ne: सर्वत्र अनुभव गर्न सकिने सङ्कर्षण देवता यही प्रकृतिभित्र प्रवेश गरेर सुरुमा जल सृष्टि गर्छन्। त्यसपछि ती जलमा आफ्नो तेज अर्थात् बीजरूप शक्ति राख्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Saṅkarṣaṇa, the god who is perceptible everywhere and pervades all things, enters within prakṛti and at the beginning of creation first produces the waters. He then places his vīrya, his seed-like power, into those waters. The verse describes this as the first act of creation.

commentaries.ne:
शुद्ध ब्रह्मले जगत् कारण हुन सम्भव नहुने भएकाले यसो भनिएको हो।
प्रकृत्यन्तर्गतः भन्नाले ब्रह्मी माया हुने प्रकृतिभित्र रहेको, र मायाले उपहित भएको भन्ने अर्थ हो।
बहिरन्तश्च सर्वगः भन्नाले बाहिर र भित्र दुवैतिर व्याप्त हुनु हो, किनभने उहाँ जगत्का उपादान कारण हुनुहुन्छ।
यी सबै विशेषण वासुदेवका अंश सङ्कर्षणमा लागू हुन्छन्, किनभने अंश वासुदेवात्मक भएकाले उहाँसँग एकरूप मानेर बुझ्नुपर्छ।
आदौ भन्नाले सबैभन्दा पहिले।
अपः भन्नाले जल।
सृष्ट्वा भन्नाले निर्माण गरेर।
वीर्यम् भन्नाले शक्तिविशेष।
अवासृजत् भन्नाले राखे वा प्रक्षेप गरे भन्ने अर्थ हो।
commentaries.en:
Pure Brahman cannot be the cause of the world, so the verse says this in a qualified way.
prakṛtyantargataḥ: situated within prakṛti, which is Brahmi māyā, and conditioned by māyā.
bahirantaś ca sarvagaḥ: pervading both outside and inside, because he is the material cause (upādāna) of the world.
All these epithets are to be understood as applying to Saṅkarṣaṇa, the part of Vāsudeva, through the identification of that part with Vāsudeva, since it is of Vāsudeva's nature.
ādau: first, before everything else.
apaḥ: the waters.
sṛṣṭvā: having created.
vīryam: a particular power (śakti-viśeṣa).
avāsṛjat: threw in, placed.

commentaries.ne:
तत्त्वामृतको व्याख्या अनुसार प्रकृति ब्रह्मी माया हो, र वासुदेवको अंश सङ्कर्षण मायाले उपहित भएर त्यसभित्र रहन्छन्।
जगत् उत्पादन गर्ने भएकाले उहाँ बाहिर र भित्र दुवैतिर व्यापक (व्यापक) हुनुहुन्छ।
सङ्कर्षण वासुदेवको अंश हुनुहुने देवका रूपमा नाम दिइएको हो।
आदौ भन्नाले सबैभन्दा पहिले।
अपः भन्नाले जल।
सृष्ट्वा भन्नाले निर्माण गरेर।
तासु भन्नाले ती जलमा।
वीर्यम् भन्नाले शक्तिविशेष।
अवासृजत् भन्नाले राखे वा प्रक्षेप गरे भन्ने अर्थ हो।
commentaries.en:
Tattvamṛta gloss on the verse: prakṛti is Brahmi māyā, and Saṅkarṣaṇa, a part of Vāsudeva, is situated within it while conditioned by māyā.
Jagadutpādakatvād: because it produces the world, he is both outside and inside, all-pervading (vyāpaka).
Saṅkarṣaṇa is named as the god who is Vāsudeva's part.
ādau: from the very first, before anything else.
apaḥ: the waters.
sṛṣṭvā: having created.
tāsu: in them (the waters).
vīryam: a particular power (śakti-viśeṣa).
avāsṛjat: placed, cast in.

commentaries.ne: मिश्रको भाषा टीकाले यी विशेषण वासुदेवको अंश सङ्कर्षणका हुन् भनी बताउँछ, र शक्ति राख्ने काम सृष्टिको आरम्भमा एकार्णवमा हुन्छ भन्छ।
commentaries.en: Mishra's Hindi tika says the verse's epithets are the characteristics of Saṅkarṣaṇa, a part of Vāsudeva, and that the act of casting power into the primordial ocean (ekārṇava) occurs at the beginning of creation.

shlokas.sanskrit: तदण्डमभवद् हैमं सर्वत्र तमसावृतम् । तत्रानिरुद्धः प्रथमं व्यक्तीभूतः सनातनः
shlokas.meaning_ne: सङ्कर्षणको वीर्य पानीसँग मिलेपछि सुनौलो अण्डा बन्यो, जुन चारैतिरबाट अन्धकारले ढाकिएको छ। त्यसभित्र सर्वप्रथम सनातन अनिरुद्ध प्रकट भए।
shlokas.meaning_en: The seed-power of Saṅkarṣaṇa, joined with the waters, became a golden egg, covered on all sides by darkness. Within that egg the eternal Aniruddha first became manifest.

commentaries.ne:
tat (त्यसद्वारा): पानीमा राखिएको सङ्कर्षणको वीर्यशक्तिद्वारा (पानीसँग संयोग भएको)।
sarvatra: भित्र र बाहिर।
tamasāvṛtam: अन्धकारले ढाकिएको।
haimam: सुनौलो। aṇḍam: गोरुको छालाजस्तो वा अण्डाजस्तो आकारको पिण्ड; यो उत्पन्न भयो (prādurabhūt)।
tatra: त्यो सुनौलो पिण्डभित्र। prathamam: पहिले। sanātanaḥ: नित्य। अनिरुद्ध: व्यक्त भए (vyaktībhūtaḥ, आफैं दृष्टिगोचर भए)।
आपत्ति: यदि नित्य अनिरुद्ध व्यक्त भए भने उनलाई उत्पन्न भनिएको कसरी मान्ने?
उत्तर: अनिरुद्ध वासुदेवको अंश हुन् र नित्य हुन्, त्यसैले उनी उत्पन्न भएका होइनन्। व्यक्त भएको चाहिँ सुनौलो पिण्ड नै अनिरुद्धको रूपमा थियो, त्यसैले विरोध छैन।
commentaries.en:
tat (by that): by the virile power of Saṅkarṣaṇa placed in water (joined with the waters).
sarvatra: inside and outside.
tamasāvṛtam: covered by darkness.
haimam: golden. aṇḍam: a lump shaped like a cow's hide or an egg; it came into being (prādurabhūt).
tatra: in that golden lump. prathamam: first. sanātanaḥ: eternal. Aniruddha: became manifest (vyaktībhūtaḥ, made perceptible to the senses, come into view of its own accord).
Objection: if the eternal Aniruddha is manifested, how can he be said to be produced?
Answer: Aniruddha is a portion of Vāsudeva and eternal, so he is not produced. What became manifest was the golden lump itself, in the form of Aniruddha.

shlokas.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भो भगवानेष छन्दसि पठ्यते । आदित्यो ह्यादिभूतत्वात् प्रसूत्या सूर्य उच्यते
shlokas.meaning_ne: यिनै भगवान् हिरण्यगर्भ हुन्, जसको उल्लेख वेदमा गरिएको छ। पहिले नै प्रकट भएकाले (आदिभूत भएकाले) उहाँलाई आदित्य भनिन्छ, र उहाँबाट जगत् उत्पन्न हुने भएकाले उहाँलाई सूर्य भनिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: This Lord, Hiranyagarbha, is named in the Vedas. Because he is the first to become manifest (ādibhūta), he is called Āditya, and because the world is brought forth from him, he is called Sūrya.

commentaries.ne:
यो एष सङ्कर्षणको अंश, षड्गुण ऐश्वर्यले सम्पन्न भगवान् अनिरुद्ध, वेदमा हिरण्यगर्भ भनेर पढिन्छ।
सुनको अण्डाको बीचमा गर्भरूपमा रहेकाले उहाँलाई हिरण्यगर्भ भनिएको हो।
वेदमा 'हिरण्यगर्भ' भन्ने नाम प्रसिद्ध अर्को नाम हो।
'हि' को अर्थ निश्चय हो।
सबैभन्दा पहिले प्रकट भएकाले (सर्वतः प्रथमं अभिव्यक्तत्वात्) उहाँलाई आदित्य भनिन्छ।
उहाँबाट जगत् प्रकट हुने भएकाले (प्रसूत्या, जगदुत्पत्तितया) यो अनिरुद्धलाई सूर्य भनिन्छ।
वेदको प्रमाण: 'सृष्टि हुनुअघि हिरण्यगर्भ प्रकट भयो; जन्मिएका सबै प्राणीको एक मात्र पति उहाँ नै थिए।' अर्को श्रुति भन्छ, 'सूर्य चल्ने र नचल्ने जगत्को आत्मा हो।'
commentaries.en:
Eṣa, this Saṅkarṣaṇa-aṃśa, who is the Lord Aniruddha endowed with the six excellences, is recited in the Veda as Hiranyagarbha.
He is so called because he was situated, in the form of a womb, inside the golden egg (suvarṇāṇḍamadhyarūpagarbhe sthitatvāt).
Hiranyagarbha is a well-known other name of him in the Veda.
Hi means 'certainly'.
He is called Āditya because he was manifested first of all (sarvataḥ prathamam abhivyaktatvāt).
He is called Sūrya because the world is manifested through him (prasūtyā, jagadutpattitayā).
The Veda confirms this: 'Hiranyagarbha arose in the beginning; he alone was the lord of all beings born.' Another śruti says, 'Sūrya is the self of the moving and the unmoving world.'

commentaries.ne: कपिलेश्वरले पनि रङ्गनाथकै जस्तै श्लोकको अर्थ बुझाउनुभएको छ। हिरण्यगर्भ अनिरुद्ध हुन्, जो सुनौलो अण्डा भित्र प्रकट हुनुभयो, त्यसैले वेदले उहाँलाई हिरण्यगर्भ भन्छ। 'आदिभूतत्व' भनेको सबै तरिकाले पहिले प्रकट हुनु हो, जसबाट आदित्य नाम आउँछ। 'प्रसूति' भनेको जगत् उहाँबाट उत्पन्न हुने भएकाले उहाँलाई सूर्य भनिएको हो।
commentaries.en: Kapileshwar explains the verse as Ranganatha does. Hiranyagarbha is Aniruddha, who was manifested inside the golden egg, and so the Veda names him Hiranyagarbha. 'Ādibhūtatva' means first manifested in every way, which gives the name Āditya. 'Prasūti' means that because the world is produced from him, he is called Sūrya.

shlokas.sanskrit: आदित्यवर्ण तमसस्तु पारे इति श्रुति: । एष सविता भूतभावन: प्राण्युत्पत्ति स्थिति संहारकारको भुवनानि वक्ष्यमाणानि भावयन्‌ प्रकाशयन्‌ पर्य्येति सुवर्णाण्डमध्ये सदा भ्रमति
shlokas.meaning_ne: सविता नाम यस्लाई दिइएको हो किनभने उनी परम ज्योति हुन् र सूर्य तथा अन्धकारभन्दा पर छन्, अनि अन्धकार नाश गर्छन्। प्राणीहरूको पोषण गर्ने (भूतभावन) उनी प्राणीहरूको उत्पत्ति, स्थिति र संहार गर्छन्। उनी सुवर्णाण्डभित्र सधैं घुम्छन् र अगाडि वर्णन गरिने लोकहरूलाई प्रकाशित गर्छन्।
shlokas.meaning_en: Savitā is so called because he is supreme light and lies beyond the sun and beyond darkness, destroying darkness. As the nourisher of beings (bhūtabhāvana) who creates, sustains and dissolves living things, he moves always within the golden cosmic egg, illuminating the worlds that the text will describe.

commentaries.ne:
यस तपसिलमा श्रुतिको उद्धरण दिइएको छ: 'आदित्यवर्णं तमसस्तु पारे', अर्थात् आदित्यजस्तो वर्ण भएका, अन्धकारभन्दा पर।
सविता परम ज्योति हुन्, सूर्य तथा अन्धकारभन्दा पर छन्, किनभने उनले अन्धकार नाश गर्छन्।
उनी भूतभावन, प्राणीहरूको पोषक हुन्, र प्राणीहरूको उत्पत्ति, स्थिति र संहार उनैबाट हुन्छ।
उनी अगाडि वर्णन गरिने लोकहरूलाई प्रकाशित गर्छन्।
उनी सधैं सुवर्णाण्ड (सुनौलो अण्डा) भित्र घुम्छन्।
commentaries.en:
The verse is glossed with a śruti quotation: 'ādityavarṇa tamasas tu pāre', 'Aditya-coloured, beyond darkness'.
Savitā is called the supreme light, beyond the sun and beyond darkness, because he destroys darkness.
He is bhūtabhāvana, the nourisher of beings, and governs their origin, maintenance and destruction.
He illuminates the worlds that will be described later.
He always moves within the golden egg (suvarṇāṇḍa).

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रकाशात्मा तमोहन्ता महानित्येष विश्रुतः । ऋचोऽस्य मण्डलं सामान्युस्रा मूर्तिर्यजूंषि च
shlokas.meaning_ne: प्रकाश जसको आत्मा हो र अन्धकार नाश गर्ने जो हो, त्यो महान् भनेर प्रसिद्ध छ। उसको मण्डल ऋग्वेद हो, उसका किरणहरू सामवेद हुन्, र उसको मूर्ति यजुर्वेद हो। यो श्लोकले सूर्यका अंगहरूलाई वेदसँग जोडेर वर्णन गर्छ। दिइएका अंशहरूमा पण्डे वा मिश्रका अनुवाद छैनन्, त्यसैले यो भावार्थ श्लोकबाट मात्र लिइएको हो।
shlokas.meaning_en: The Sun, whose essence is light and who destroys darkness, is known as the great one. Its orb is the Rik (Rigveda), its rays are the Sāman, and its form is the Yajus. The verse uses the Vedas to describe the Sun's parts. The excerpts supplied do not contain Pandey's or Mishra's translation of this verse, so this gloss is taken from the verse itself.

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रयीमयोऽयं भगवान् कालात्मा कालकृद्विभुः । सर्वात्मा सर्वगः सूक्ष्मः सर्वमस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठितम्
shlokas.meaning_ne: भगवान् (सूर्य) तीन वेदमय छन्, काल(समय)का आत्मा र कर्ता हुन्। उनी सर्वशक्तिमान्, सबै प्राणीका आत्मा, सर्वव्यापी र सूक्ष्म छन्। सबै कुरा उनैमा प्रतिष्ठित छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: The Lord (the Sun) is made up of the three Vedas and is the soul of time and the maker of time. He is all-capable, the soul of all beings, all-pervading and subtle. Everything rests in him.

commentaries.ne:
श्लोक १७-१८ सँगै व्याख्या गरिएको छ। सूर्य प्रकाशरूप र अन्धकारनाशक हुन्, र वेद-पुराणमा अनिरुद्ध, सूर्य र महान् (महत्तत्त्व) भनेर प्रसिद्ध छन्।
ऋग्वेदका मन्त्र उनको मण्डल (गोला) हुन्, सामवेदका मन्त्र उनका किरण (उष्णाः) हुन्, र यजुर्वेदका मन्त्र उनको मूर्ति (स्वरूप) हुन्। 'च' शब्दले यिनीहरूलाई जोड्छ।
त्यसैले उनलाई भगवान् भनिन्छ, किनकि उनमा षाड्गुण्य-ऐश्वर्य छ।
त्रयीमय भन्नाले तीन वेदमय हुनु हो। कालरूप भन्नाले उनी कालका कारण हुन्।
विभु भन्नाले जगत्को उत्पत्ति, स्थिति र नाश गर्न सक्षम हुनु हो।
सर्वात्मा भन्नाले जगत्को स्वरूप हुनु; सर्वग भन्नाले सर्वत्र व्याप्त हुनु हो।
सूक्ष्म भन्नाले उनले अव्यापक (सीमित) मूर्ति पनि धारण गर्छन्।
सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् भन्नाले सम्पूर्ण जगत् यसै सूर्यमा लीन छ।
व्यापक र अव्यापक दुवै हुनुमा विरोध छैन, भन्ने कुरा पनि भनिएको छ।
commentaries.en:
The verses 17-18 are taken together. The Sun is luminous, destroys darkness, and is called Aniruddha, Sūrya and Mahān (Mahattattva), as is known in the Vedas and Purāṇas.
The Ṛg-Veda mantras are his maṇḍala (orb), the Sāma-Veda mantras are his rays (uṣṇāḥ), and the Yajur-Veda mantras are his form (mūrti). The word ca links these.
He is therefore called bhagavān, endowed with the six glories (ṣāḍguṇya-aiśvarya).
Trayīmaya means made of the three Vedas. Kālarūpa means he is the cause of time.
Vibhu means capable of creating, sustaining and destroying the world.
Sarvātmā means the form of the whole world; sarvaga means present everywhere, pervading.
Sūkṣma means he also bears an unpervasive (avyāpaka) form.
Sarvam pratiṣṭhitam means the whole world rests in this Sun.
The apparent contradiction between pervading (vyāpaka) and not pervading (avyāpaka) is resolved: there is no conflict.

commentaries.ne: तत्त्वामृत व्याख्यामा पनि उही गुणहरू बताइएका छन्। भगवान् त्रयीमय, अर्थात् तीन वेदमय छन्। उनी आफ्नो गतिबाट समय उत्पन्न गर्ने हुनाले कालात्मा र कालकृत् (कालका कारण) हुन्। उनी विभु हुन्, जगत्को सृष्टि, स्थिति र लय गर्न सक्षम छन्। सूर्यबिना कसैको पनि जीवन सम्भव नहुने हुनाले उनी सर्वात्मा हुन्। सबै प्राणी उनको स्वरूप भएकाले उनी सर्वग (सर्वव्यापी) हुन्। उनी सूक्ष्म पनि छन्, किनकि उनले अव्यापक मूर्ति धारण गर्छन्। सबै कुरा उनैमा लीन छन्, अर्थात् उनीमा स्थित छन्।
commentaries.en: The Tattvamṛta commentary explains the same qualities. The Lord is trayīmaya, consisting of the three Vedas. He is the soul of time, because he produces time through his motion, and so he is called kālakṛt, the cause of time. He is vibhu, able to create, sustain and dissolve the world. He is sarvātmā, since nothing lives without the Sun. He is sarvaga, pervading all, because all beings are his form. He is sūkṣma, since he also bears an unpervasive form. All things rest in him, that is, they are absorbed in him.

commentaries.ne: मिश्रको भाषा टीकामा भगवान् अणिमा आदि (अष्टसिद्धि) गुणले युक्त छन् भनिएको छ, जुन षाड्गुण्य-ऐश्वर्यमा निहित छन्।
commentaries.en: Mishra's Hindi tika adds that the Lord is endowed with aṇimā and the other powers (aṣṭa-siddhi), which are the qualities implied by ṣāḍguṇya-aiśvarya.

shlokas.sanskrit: रथे विश्वमये चक्रं कृत्वा संवत्सरात्मकम् । छन्दांस्यश्वाः सप्त युक्ताः पर्यट्त्येष सर्वदा
shlokas.meaning_ne: विश्वरूपी रथमा संवत्सरात्मक चक्र राखिएको छ र छन्दरूपी सात घोडा जोतिएका छन्। यही रथमा चढेर भगवान् सूर्य सधैं परिभ्रमण गर्छन्। पाण्डेयको हिन्दी अनुवादले पनि यही अर्थ दिन्छ।
shlokas.meaning_en: On a chariot made of the universe, with the wheel in the form of the year fixed on it and the seven metres yoked as horses, this one (the Sun) always travels around. Pandey's Hindi translation gives the same sense: the Sun, the lord, always goes about on the universal chariot, with the year-wheel set on it and the metres yoked as its horses.

commentaries.ne:
पर्येति भुवनानि एषः भन्ने पदांशलाई व्याख्या गर्दै त्रिलोकरूप रथ भनिएको हो।
बाह्र महिनाको संवत्सरात्मक वर्षचक्र यस रथमा जोडिएको छ।
गायत्री, उष्णिक्, अनुष्टुप्, बृहती, पंक्ति, त्रिष्टुप् र जगती, यी सात छन्द नै जोडिएका सात घोडा हुन्।
वैकल्पिक पाठ 'छन्दांसि अश्वास्तत्र युक्ता' अनुसार सात घोडा रथमा जोडिएका हुन्।
एषः भनेको नाम अनुसार अनिरुद्ध अर्थात् सूर्य हो।
सर्वदा भनेको सधैं र पर्यटति भनेको घुम्छ वा परिभ्रमण गर्छ हो।
commentaries.en:
The first half (paryeti bhuvanani eshah) is explained as: the chariot has the form of the three worlds (trilokyatmake rathe).
The year-wheel of twelve months (dvadasha-masatmaka varsha-chakra) is fixed on this chariot.
The seven metres, Gayatri, Ushnik, Anushtubh, Brihati, Pankti, Trishtubh and Jagati, are the seven horses yoked to it.
An alternative reading, 'chandansi ashvas tatra yukta', means that the seven horses are yoked to the chariot.
'Eshah' is Anirudha by name, the Sun.
'Sarvada' means always, and 'paryatati' means wanders or goes around.

commentaries.ne:
रथ ब्रह्माण्डात्मक हो।
